Associated with neurological abnormalities including polymicrogyria and corpus callosum agenesis. Despite initial surgical excision, recurrence occurred in parapharyngeal region with fatal airway obstruction at 14 months.

pmid-32833816.summary_ja: 24歳男性の蝶形骨に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。頭痛と顔面のしびれを主訴とし、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍として発生した。経鼻的経翼突骨アプローチで治療され、18か月のフォローアップで再発は認められなかった。まれな部位に対する低侵襲な手術手技を示している。
pmid-32833816.summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old adult with mature teratoma of sphenoid bone. Extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with headache and facial numbness. Successfully managed via endonasal transpterygoid approach with 18-month follow-up demonstrating no recurrence. Demonstrates effective minimally invasive surgical technique for rare GCT location.

pmid-32852753.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肉眼所見と組織学的特徴の記述。臨床管理と研究解釈に必須な多様な組織型。免疫組織化学による診断補助について。
pmid-32852753.summary_en: Overview of macroscopic and light microscopic features of testicular germ cell tumors commonly encountered in clinical practice. Covers diverse histology essential for accurate diagnosis and clinical management. Discusses immunohistochemistry as diagnostic aid for identification of histologic subtypes.

pmid-32852754.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の診断と分類における免疫組織化学法の臨床応用。困難な診断例における有用性。予後予測における確立された役割はない。
pmid-32852754.summary_en: Clinical applications of immunohistochemistry including nuclear transcription factors for germ cell tumor diagnosis and classification. Reviews diagnostic utility in challenging cases and confirming germ cell origin in metastatic tumors. Discusses technical aspects and commonly used IHC markers.

pmid-32852755.summary_ja: レーザーキャプチャーマイクロダイセクション法による精巣胚細胞腫瘍の正確な分子解析。次世代シーケンシング併用による多層的プロファイリング。
pmid-32852755.summary_en: Laser-assisted microdissection methods for precise isolation of germ cell tumor cells from routine pathology specimens. Combined with next-generation sequencing for genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic analysis. Enables precision medicine approaches and translational research in testicular cancer management.

pmid-32852756.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における12p染色体異常検出のためのFISH法。ほぼすべてのGCT組織型に認められ、診断とシスプラチン感受性予測に有用。
pmid-32852756.summary_en: Fluorescence in situ hybridization protocol for detecting chromosome 12p anomalies including isochromosome 12p and overrepresentation in germ cell tumors. Present in virtually all GCT subtypes and locations. Useful for GCT diagnosis and identifying patients potentially benefiting from cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-32852757.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍細胞株の培養最適化法。日常的培養、凍結保存、細胞生存率測定。腫瘍の異質性と個別最適条件への対応。
pmid-32852757.summary_en: Optimization protocols for culturing diverse germ cell tumor cell lines. Covers routine culture, cryopreservation methods, and cell viability and proliferation measurements. Addresses heterogeneity of GCTs and variable optimal culture conditions between different cell lines.

pmid-32852759.summary_ja: セミノーマ（TCam-2）、胎児性癌（NCCIT、NT2/D1、2102EP）、絨毛癌（JEG-3、JAR）の各細胞株に代表される精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株の培養法をまとめた方法論である。標準的な培養プロトコルと、CRISPR/Cas9を用いて遺伝子編集サブクローンを樹立する手法が記載されている。
pmid-32852759.summary_en: Methods for culturing testicular germ cell tumor cell lines representing seminoma (TCam-2), embryonal carcinoma (NCCIT, NT2/D1, 2102EP), and choriocarcinoma (JEG-3, JAR). Describes standard cultivation protocols and CRISPR/Cas9-based gene editing techniques for establishing gene-edited subclones.

pmid-32852761.summary_ja: 胚細胞癌GCT細胞株における相同組換えと鎖間架橋修復の評価法。複数細胞株の比較測定。シスプラチン耐性メカニズムの解析。
pmid-32852761.summary_en: GFP-based assays measuring homologous recombination and interstrand cross-link repair in embryonal carcinoma germ cell tumor cell lines. Adapted protocols enable testing multiple cell lines for DNA repair proficiency. Characterizes recombination profile and potential cisplatin resistance mechanisms in TGCT cells.

pmid-32852763.summary_ja: 悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマウスモデル作製法。がん幹細胞分析と化学療法反応評価の方法。ヒトの悪性転移性疾患に類似したモデル。
pmid-32852763.summary_en: Methods for generating genetically engineered mouse model of malignant testicular germ cell tumors. Model closely resembles malignant, metastatic disease in humans. Describes techniques for analyzing cancer stem cells and chemotherapeutic responses. Addresses limitations of existing benign teratoma models in studying malignant TGCTs.

pmid-32852766.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的素因評価のためのゲノムワイド関連解析法。DNA抽出、品質評価、アレイベース遺伝型判定、バリアント検証法を記述。
pmid-32852766.summary_en: Genome-wide association study (GWAS) methods for identifying genetic predisposition to testicular germ cell tumors. Describes DNA extraction, quality assessment, array-based genotyping using Illumina platform, and variant validation. Identifies common germline variants and pathways relevant to GCT biology without a priori hypotheses.

pmid-32852767.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の診断と監視のためのマイクロRNAパネル定量法。複数miRNAの感度の高い測定。血清サンプルの品質評価と多重RT増幅法を含む。
pmid-32852767.summary_en: Optimized reverse transcription quantitative PCR protocol for measuring microRNA panel (miR-371a-3p, miR-372-3p, miR-373-3p, miR-367-3p) in serum. Enables highly sensitive and specific germ cell tumor diagnosis and monitoring. Includes serum sample quality assessment and multiplex preamplification techniques.

pmid-32852768.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の循環腫瘍細胞(CTC)を検出する方法を述べた論文。GCTの組織学的な異質性と細胞特性を整理し、細胞密度に基づく標識非依存的な捕捉法と上皮マーカーを用いた濃縮技術を紹介している。これにより、血液から生存可能なGCT細胞を単離することを目指す。
pmid-32852768.summary_en: Methods for detecting circulating tumor cells (CTCs) in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Reviews heterogeneous histology and cell characteristics of GCTs. Describes label-independent capture methods based on cell density and epithelial marker-based enrichment techniques for isolating viable GCT cells from blood.

pmid-32852769.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の分子的基盤研究を促進するゲノムデータコモンズの設計。公開データベースのレビューとGCT Explorerポータルの導入により、データ共有と分析を容易にする。
pmid-32852769.summary_en: Review and design of genomic data commons for germ cell tumor research. Discusses publicly available GCT databases and introduces GCT Explorer portal for data storage, management, searching, and analysis. Facilitates molecular basis exploration and translational research by enabling data sharing among institutions addressing rarity of GCTs.

pmid-32856977.summary_ja: 精巣混合胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。皮膚転移で発症し、エストラジオールとhCGの同時分泌を示した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異常なホルモン分泌と転移パターンを報告。
pmid-32856977.summary_en: Case report of 28-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with cutaneous metastasis following orchiectomy. Tumor characterized by rare autonomous estradiol and hCG cosecretion. Highlights unusual endocrine manifestations and atypical metastatic patterns in testicular germ cell malignancies.

pmid-32856980.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍診断のためのmiR-371a-3pの臨床応用。従来型マーカーより感度が高く、腫瘍段階や組織型との相関がある。化学療法後の生存腫瘍検出に有用。
pmid-32856980.summary_en: Prospective evaluation of serum miR-371a-3p as biomarker for testicular germ cell tumors. Demonstrates superior sensitivity (93%) compared to conventional markers (58%). Correlates with stage and embryonal carcinoma percentage. Shows potential clinical utility for detecting viable GCT after chemotherapy and guiding treatment decisions in solitary testis cases.

pmid-32861046.summary_ja: 早期卵巣癌の治療に関する44件の研究を検討したシステマティックレビューである。胚細胞腫瘍などの非上皮性腫瘍も含まれる。妊孕性温存手術と従来の手術の生殖および腫瘍学的転帰を比較した。妊孕性温存アプローチで生存率の低下は認められなかった。妊娠率と生児出産率は一般集団と同様であり、低リスクの早期疾患に対する手術の安全性が確認された。
pmid-32861046.summary_en: Systematic review examining 44 studies on early-stage ovarian cancer management, including nonepithelial tumors such as germ cell tumors. Compared reproductive and oncologic outcomes of fertility-sparing surgery versus conventional surgery. No survival compromise with fertility-sparing approach. Pregnancy and live-birth rates comparable to general population. Surgery confirmed safe for low-risk early-stage disease.

pmid-32873866.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫、完全胞状奇胎、性腺外成熟奇形腫において、刷込み遺伝子のDNAメチル化プロファイルを比較した研究である。明確に異なるパターンが示され、細胞起源や発生経路が異なることが示唆された。
pmid-32873866.summary_en: Study comparing DNA methylation profiles of imprinted genes in mature ovarian teratomas, complete hydatidiform moles, and extragonadal mature teratomas, demonstrating distinct patterns suggesting different cell origins and developmental pathways.

pmid-32875471.summary_ja: 卵巣および性腺外部位の奇形腫について、画像および臨床的特徴を包括的にレビューしている。組織学的型や、growing teratoma syndromeなどの非典型的な所見、自己免疫性合併症を取り上げている。
pmid-32875471.summary_en: Comprehensive review of teratoma imaging and clinical features in ovarian and extragonadal sites, including histopathological types, unusual manifestations like growing teratoma syndrome and autoimmune complications.

pmid-32875900.summary_ja: クルクミンが胎児性癌細胞の分化を誘導し、遺伝子発現と膜動態を変化させることをin vitroで示した研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍および奇形癌の治療に対する治療的可能性を示唆している。
pmid-32875900.summary_en: In vitro study demonstrating curcumin-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells with altered gene expression and membrane dynamics, suggesting therapeutic potential for germ cell tumor and teratocarcinoma treatment.

pmid-32880854.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎の患者78例を対象とし、奇形腫摘出、ステロイド、IVIG、リツキシマブ、トシリズマブを組み合わせた併用免疫療法の有効性を検討したコホート研究である。治療を早期に開始した場合に、より良好な結果が示された。
pmid-32880854.summary_en: Cohort study of 78 anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients demonstrating efficacy of combined immunotherapy with teratoma removal, steroids, IVIG, rituximab and tocilizumab, with early treatment initiation showing superior outcomes.

pmid-32882201.summary_ja: 本研究は、初回化学療法のみ、または救援化学療法の後に胸部転移巣切除術を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の転帰を比較したものであり、5年全生存率は93%対63%であった。
pmid-32882201.summary_en: Comparison of thoracic metastasectomy outcomes in testicular germ cell tumor patients treated with first-line chemotherapy alone versus salvage chemotherapy, showing 5-year overall survival of 93% vs 63% respectively.

pmid-32889112.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘤146例（悪性37例、良性107例）の分析。生殖細胞腫瘍を含む悪性病変が存在するが、悪性度が低く卵巣温存手術が第一選択となる。
pmid-32889112.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 146 pediatric and adolescent patients with ovarian masses including 37 malignant and 107 benign lesions, with ovarian-preserving surgery recommended given low malignancy rates.

pmid-32889680.summary_ja: 縦隔巨大成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対し術前経皮的穿刺排液により循環虚脱を回避した症例。体外循環の代替戦略を示す。
pmid-32889680.summary_en: Case report of giant mediastinal mature cystic teratoma managed with preoperative percutaneous drainage to avoid hemodynamic collapse, demonstrating alternative to extracorporeal life support during anesthesia.

pmid-32901295.summary_ja: 精巣がん第1期の経過観察における造影なしMRIの診断能を検討。放射線科医の経験度により感度75～100%の差が認められた。
pmid-32901295.summary_en: Retrospective study of unenhanced MRI for surveillance of 23 stage 1 testicular cancer patients, showing sensitivity and specificity of 75-100% for detecting metastatic lymphadenopathy depending on radiologist experience.

pmid-32907779.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法後に完全奏効を得た191例の長期監視成績を報告する、これまでで最大規模のシリーズである。91.6%が無病で経過し、8.4%が晩期に再発した。監視療法が安全かつ有効な戦略であることが示された。
pmid-32907779.summary_en: Largest series of long-term surveillance outcomes in 191 metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients achieving complete response after chemotherapy, with 91.6% remaining disease-free and 8.4% experiencing late relapses.

pmid-32915080.summary_ja: 早期精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する監視療法、化学療法、放射線療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を比較したシステマティックレビューである。いずれの戦略でもがん特異的生存率は90%を超えたが、再発率や毒性プロファイルは異なっていた。患者ごとの選好に合わせて各アプローチの特徴を伝えることが重要であるとしている。
pmid-32915080.summary_en: Systematic review comparing surveillance, primary chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for early stage testicular germ cell tumors, showing >90% cancer-specific survival with all strategies but differing recurrence rates and toxicity profiles.

pmid-32916187.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が膀胱憩室に類似して見える症例報告。超音波検査での誤認識の可能性を示す。
pmid-32916187.summary_en: Case report of mature ovarian cystic teratoma in a 16-year-old female mimicking bladder diverticulum on sonography, with CT confirming large cystic mass of right ovarian origin.

pmid-32925407.summary_ja: 8歳男児の心室中隔原発成熟奇形腫の症例報告。心臓内は奇形腫の稀な発生部位であり、小児の心臓腫瘤の鑑別診断に含める必要がある。
pmid-32925407.summary_en: Case report of primary intracardiac mature teratoma in an 8-year-old boy with cystic mass originating from the interventricular septum, highlighting a rare cardiac location for this germ cell tumor.

pmid-32928566.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた思春期・若年成人の胚細胞がん患者の米国集団ベース解析。長期生存は良好である一方、胃、膵臓、軟部組織などで二次性悪性腫瘍のリスクが有意に上昇していた。
pmid-32928566.summary_en: US population-based analysis of adolescent and young adult germ cell cancer patients using SEER data, showing excellent long-term survival and significantly elevated risks of secondary malignancies at stomach, pancreas, and soft tissue sites.

pmid-32950035.summary_ja: 小児成熟卵巣奇形腫120例の20年間の経験。卵巣温存手術は捻転例や両側病変例を含めて安全有効であり、第一選択手術とすべきことを示す。
pmid-32950035.summary_en: Twenty-year single-center experience with 120 pediatric patients with mature ovarian teratomas, demonstrating safety and efficacy of ovarian sparing tumorectomy including in cases with torsion and bilateral disease.

pmid-32955662.summary_ja: 化学療法後の残存腫瘍を有する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者45例を後方視的に解析した。ロボット支援残存腫瘤切除後、病理では奇形腫が最も多く認められた。無再発生存率は良好であった。
pmid-32955662.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 45 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients undergoing robot-assisted residual mass resection after chemotherapy, showing 5-year recurrence-free survival of 98% with teratoma as the most common pathological finding.

pmid-32958338.summary_ja: 肺および脳転移を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。精巣摘除術、化学療法、全脳放射線療法を受けた後、多数の放射線誘発性海綿状血管腫が生じた。
pmid-32958338.summary_en: Case report of mixed germ cell tumor with lung and brain metastases treated with orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and whole-brain radiotherapy, subsequently developing numerous radiation-induced cavernous malformations.

pmid-32960421.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性生殖細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で生存可能腫瘍を有する32例の分析。手術切除縁と二次化学療法が無再発生存と全生存の独立した予測因子である。
pmid-32960421.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 32 patients with viable tumor after post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, identifying surgical margin status and second-line chemotherapy as independent predictors of survival outcomes.

pmid-32960496.summary_ja: COGおよびSIOPにおける小児の神経膠腫、ジャーミノーマ、非ジャーミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の現在の多様式治療アプローチをまとめている。外科手術、放射線療法、化学療法の役割と、今後の研究戦略を含む。
pmid-32960496.summary_en: Summarizes current multimodality treatment approaches for pediatric gliomas, germinomas, and nongerminomatous germ cell tumors from COG and SIOP, including roles of surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy with future research strategies.

pmid-32978641.summary_ja: 32週妊娠時に破裂した巨大未成熟仙骨尾骨部奇形腫と視床下部過誤腫の稀な合併例。出血性ショックで緊急帝王切開と腫瘍摘出術施行。
pmid-32978641.summary_en: Case of ruptured giant immature sacrococcygeal teratoma at 32-week gestation with hemorrhagic shock requiring emergency delivery. Associated hypothalamic hamartoma confirmed by biopsy. First reported combination. Urgent surgical removal of teratoma performed successfully.

pmid-32979534.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢胞233例中、抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う稀な症例2例を報告。年齢21・42歳、嚢胞径15-80mm。免疫療法により良好に軽快。
pmid-32979534.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 233 ovarian dermoid cyst cases identified 2 cases (0.85%) with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Patients aged 21 and 42 with cyst diameters 15-80mm. Both successfully managed with laparoscopic surgery, plasmapheresis, immunoglobulins, and corticosteroids.

pmid-32980271.summary_ja: 進行期セミノーマ患者70例の化学療法2コース後のPET/CT陰性が優れた無再発生存率(5年97.8%)を予測。早期評価による層別化の有用性を示唆。
pmid-32980271.summary_en: Prospective study of 70 advanced seminoma patients receiving BEP chemotherapy. PET/CT negative after 2 cycles predicted excellent 5-year relapse-free survival (97.8%) versus 75% for PET-positive patients (P=0.002). Early interim imaging may optimize prognostic risk stratification.

pmid-32991342.summary_ja: 肝様奇形腫2例、肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍12例、肝細胞癌16例の組織学的・免疫組織学的比較。各種病理学的特徴で鑑別可能。
pmid-32991342.summary_en: Morphologic and immunohistochemical comparison of 2 hepatoid teratomas (HT), 12 hepatoid yolk sac tumors (HYST), and 16 hepatocellular carcinomas. Hepatoid teratomas showed ductules and biliary structures, SALL4/CDX2 negativity, consistent arginase and HepPar-1 positivity distinguishing from HYST.

pmid-33010987.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者185例の後方視的研究で、リンパ節密度と再発との間に負の相関が認められた。追跡期間中央値は79か月で、再発は5例（2.7%）であった。リンパ節密度は化学療法後のリスク層別化のための新たな予後マーカーとして提案されている。
pmid-33010987.summary_en: Retrospective study of 185 testicular GCT patients found negative correlation between lymph node density and recurrence. Median follow-up 79 months with 5 recurrences (2.7%). Lymph node density proposed as novel prognostic marker for risk stratification after chemotherapy.

pmid-33011741.summary_ja: プラチナ製剤治療後の精巣がん生存者における心血管疾患発症の遺伝的素因を解析。10のバイオロジカルテーマを同定し、血管内皮活性化が主要経路。
pmid-33011741.summary_en: Genome-wide association study identified genetic variation mediating cardiovascular disease risk in platinum-treated testicular cancer survivors. RAC2/RAC3 endothelial activation network identified as prominent biological theme. Circulating endothelial cells increased during chemotherapy.

pmid-33017201.summary_ja: 初回発症の2～19年後に生じた異時性GCTの3症例。分子解析により、腫瘍の起源が異なるか化学療法抵抗性クローンの存在が示唆された。胚発生中の複数の原始生殖細胞の誤移動が、稀な多発性独立GCTの機序として提案されている。
pmid-33017201.summary_en: Three cases of metachronous GCTs occurring 2-19 years after initial presentation. Molecular analysis suggested distinct tumor origins or chemotherapy-resistant clones. Multiple primordial germ cell mismigrations during embryogenesis proposed as mechanism for rare multiple independent GCTs.

pmid-33029924.summary_ja: 成人のMGCT 28例を対象とした研究。セミノーマでは良好な成績(3年全生存率100%)だが、非セミノーマ性腫瘍は予後不良であった。プラチナ併用化学療法と化学療法後の手術により、3年無増悪生存率は61.2%であった。約4分の1が上大静脈閉塞症候群で発症した。
pmid-33029924.summary_en: Study of 28 mediastinal GCT patients found excellent outcomes in seminoma (100% 3-year survival) but poor prognosis in non-seminomatous tumors. Platinum-based chemotherapy with post-chemotherapy surgery achieved 61.2% 3-year progression-free survival. One-quarter presented with superior vena cava obstruction.

pmid-33031755.summary_ja: 完全奇胎患者39名のマイクロRNA解析で、絨毛性疾患への進行予測マーカーとしてmiR-181ファミリーを同定。BCL2発現低下が進行と関連。
pmid-33031755.summary_en: MicroRNA sequencing of 39 complete hydatidiform moles identified distinct miR-181 family signatures predicting gestational trophoblastic neoplasia progression. BCL2 downregulation associated with malignant transformation. Immunohistochemistry validation confirmed BCL2 as prognostic biomarker.

pmid-33037172.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者150例において、無増悪生存期間を予測する15の選択的スプライシングイベントをRNAシーケンスにより同定した。選択的スプライシングスコアは、従来の病期分類マーカーと比較して優れた予後予測能（AUC 0.899）を示した。経路解析ではDNA修復遺伝子の濃縮が認められた。
pmid-33037172.summary_en: RNA-seq identified 15 alternative splicing events predicting progression-free survival in 150 testicular GCT patients. Alternative splicing score had superior prognostic value (AUC 0.899) compared to conventional staging markers. Pathway analysis revealed DNA repair gene enrichment.

pmid-33038285.summary_ja: DHODH阻害剤ブレキナルが多能性幹細胞を選別的に除去し、奇形腫形成を抑制。細胞治療における安全性向上の新戦略を提唱。
pmid-33038285.summary_en: DHODH inhibitor brequinar selectively eliminated pluripotent stem cells while sparing differentiated cells. Brequinar-pretreated cells failed to form teratomas in transplanted mice. Administration prevented tumor growth in teratoma-bearing mice without affecting differentiated tissue.

pmid-33045371.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢胞内に歯を含む下顎骨様構造を有する症例を腹腔鏡下に管理。関節鏡用ブレードによる細切化により開腹術を回避。
pmid-33045371.summary_en: Case report of adolescent girl with mandibular structure containing teeth in ovarian dermoid cyst managed via laparoscopic cystectomy. Novel use of arthroscopic blade for morcellation enabled specimen extraction without laparotomy, demonstrating successful minimally invasive approach.

pmid-33047348.summary_ja: 日本人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例を標的シーケンシングで解析し、低い変異率(0.89変異/Mb)と18個の新規変異を同定した。KIT-PI3K-AKT経路の変異は27.3%の症例で検出された。セミノーマ1例でPDGFRA増幅が認められた。
pmid-33047348.summary_en: Targeted sequencing of 21 Japanese testicular GCT patients identified low mutation rate (0.89 mutations/Mb) and 18 novel mutations. KIT-PI3K-AKT pathway mutations detected in 27.3% of cases. PDGFRA amplification found in one seminoma case.

pmid-33049521.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に特異的なマーカーとして第19染色体マイクロRNAクラスターおよびmiR-371a-3pを同定し、疾患活動性の把握において従来のhCGより優れていることを示した。これらのマイクロRNAは治療開始後に急速に低下し、2回目の化学療法の前に正常化しており、hCGよりも治療反応をよく反映していた。
pmid-33049521.summary_en: Identified chromosome-19-microRNA-cluster and miR-371a-3p as choriocarcinoma-specific biomarkers superior to conventional hCG in tracking disease activity. These microRNAs declined rapidly with treatment initiation and normalized before second chemotherapy course, better reflecting disease response than hCG.

pmid-33049748.summary_ja: 化学療法後の奇形腫患者の嚢胞液中マイクロRNA-371a-3pが血清正常化後も高値を示した。嚢胞内液体が排液経路を欠くため、マイクロRNAが蓄積される機序を提唱。
pmid-33049748.summary_en: Four patients with post-chemotherapy residual teratoma showed elevated microRNA-371a-3p in cystic fluid despite normal serum levels. Suggests miR-371 accumulation in cyst lumen due to lack of drainage system. Findings enhance understanding of novel GCT biomarker biology and implications for clinical monitoring.

pmid-33052518.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ患者においてシスプラチン化学療法後、腎臓がん・膀胱がんの二次悪性腫瘍リスクが増加。10年全生存率91.8%と良好。二次悪性腫瘍の予後は他の腫瘍型より良好。
pmid-33052518.summary_en: Study of 10,734 testicular nonseminoma patients found elevated risk of secondary kidney (SIR 2.13) and bladder cancers (SIR 1.47) but decreased prostate cancer risk after cisplatin chemotherapy. Excellent 10-year overall survival of 91.8%; urological secondary neoplasms had better prognosis than other malignancies.

pmid-33059908.summary_ja: 外科手術を受けた小児後腹膜奇形腫91例の後方視的解析。78%が1歳以下であった。41%に術周術期合併症が認められた。腫瘍によって圧排・偏位される臓器の数が、合併症と独立して関連していた。完全切除は通常根治的である。
pmid-33059908.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 91 pediatric retroperitoneal teratoma (RPT) cases undergoing surgery. 78% were ≤1 year old. 41% had perioperative complications. Number of organs compressed/distorted by tumor independently associated with complications. Complete resection usually curative.

pmid-33079404.summary_ja: 11の臨床試験からの転移性GCT患者593名の分析。青少年の5年無イベント生存率72%は小児より有意に低く、成人と類似。治療アプローチ調整の必要性を示唆。
pmid-33079404.summary_en: Analysis of 593 patients (90 children, 109 adolescents, 394 young adults) with metastatic GCTs from 11 trials. 5-year event-free survival for adolescents (72%) significantly lower than children (90%) but similar to young adults (88%), highlighting need for coordinated treatment initiatives.

pmid-33102131.summary_ja: 成人男性における停留精巣と腹腔内腫瘤の症例報告。新生児期からの早期管理の重要性と停留精巣の悪性腫瘍リスク増加を強調。
pmid-33102131.summary_en: Case report of cryptorchidism (undescended testis) with intra-abdominal mass in adult male. Highlights importance of early management and increased malignancy risk in cryptorchid testes when presenting in adulthood.

pmid-33103860.summary_ja: Stage I精巣セミノーマ患者153名のカルボプラチン補助療法の長期成績。15年無再発生存率99.4%、全生存率91.4%。
pmid-33103860.summary_en: Long-term outcomes of 153 Stage I seminoma patients receiving two cycles of adjuvant carboplatin (AUC7). 15-year relapse-free survival 99.4%, overall survival 91.4%, subsequent malignant neoplasm rate 7.6%, second TGCT rate 3.85%.

pmid-33119475.summary_ja: 4,755名の精巣GCT患者における対側精巣腫瘍発生リスクの全国研究。20年での累積発生率3.4%。白金化学療法サイクルと対側腫瘍発生リスクに逆相関。
pmid-33119475.summary_en: Nationwide cohort study of 4,755 testicular GCT patients examining metachronous contralateral TGCT risk. 136 CTGCT cases developed. Cumulative incidence at 20 years: 3.4%. Platinum chemotherapy showed dose-dependent inverse association with CTGCT risk.

pmid-33121935.summary_ja: 120名の精巣がん生存者における生活の質調査。28%が診療ガイドライン非準拠治療を受けた。非準拠治療は全般的健康状態低下および経済的困難と関連。
pmid-33121935.summary_en: Quality-of-life study in 120 testicular cancer survivors. 28% received non-guideline-directed care (overtreatment 44%, undertreatment 29%). NGDC associated with lower global health status, worse physical function, and greater financial burden.

pmid-33124175.summary_ja: Stage I非セミノーマGCTにおける標準的アプローチとmiRNA-371a-3p検査の比較。マイクロRNA検査により治療適正性が向上し、患者あたり約$1,400の費用削減を実現。
pmid-33124175.summary_en: Decision tree analysis comparing standard staging vs miRNA-371a-3p-based approach for Stage I NSGCT. miRNA testing improved treatment appropriateness (65%→94% Stage IA, 50%→92% Stage IB) while maintaining cost-effectiveness (~$1,400 savings/patient).

pmid-33126827.summary_ja: 白金耐性精巣GCT細胞株のDNAメチル化パターン解析。耐性は全体的なハイパーメチル化とクロマチン再構成に関連。脱メチル化療法の有用性を支持。
pmid-33126827.summary_en: Analysis of DNA methylation patterns in cisplatin-resistant testicular GCT cell lines. Cisplatin resistance associated with global DNA hypermethylation, chromatin reorganization, and altered gene expression. Supports rationale for hypomethylation therapy in refractory GCTs.

pmid-33127305.summary_ja: 絨毛膜性疾患の外科治療レビュー。胞状奇胎、侵襲性胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロフォブラスト腫瘍を含む。化学療法と手術の役割、温存治療について記載。
pmid-33127305.summary_en: Review of surgical management of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD): hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT). Discusses fertility-sparing approaches and role of chemotherapy vs surgery.

pmid-33127405.summary_ja: 胸腺成熟嚢胞性奇形腫による神経学的症状の症例報告。完全切除後症状消失。術前画像での悪性腫瘍との鑑別困難。
pmid-33127405.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma of the thymus presenting with neurologic symptoms (sensory dysfunction). Benign lesion indistinguishable from malignant anterior mediastinal masses without resection. Complete resection resulted in symptom resolution.

pmid-33128597.summary_ja: 胸腔内growing teratoma syndromeで手術を受けた29例の後方視的研究。全例でR0切除が達成された。合併症は少なく、死亡例はなかった。5年生存率は93%、15年生存率は84%であった。
pmid-33128597.summary_en: Retrospective study of 29 patients with thoracic growing teratoma syndrome undergoing surgery. R0 resection achieved in all cases. Low morbidity (3.4% minor, 6.9% major) and zero mortality. 5-year survival 93%, 15-year 84%.

pmid-33128732.summary_ja: 72歳男性の頸部リンパ節に発生した卵巣外非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。免疫組織化学によりhCG陽性を確認。稀な正中線GCTの発現形態。
pmid-33128732.summary_en: Extragonadal non-gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as cervical lymph node disease in 72-year-old man. Head and neck presentation is exceptional. Immunohistochemistry confirmed hCG-positive diagnosis. Rare midline GCT manifestation.

pmid-33129566.summary_ja: 26歳妊娠中患者における卵巣外ジスジャーミノーマの症例報告。妊娠中は画像観察のみで分娩後に手術診断。母体、胎児、腫瘍の管理が必要。
pmid-33129566.summary_en: Case report of extraovarian dysgerminoma in 26-year-old pregnant woman. Abdominal mass detected during routine prenatal ultrasound. Diagnosis confirmed after delivery via surgery. Rare presentation requiring multidisciplinary management.

pmid-33130006.summary_ja: 産後の16歳患者における絨毛癌症例。複数の腫瘍性動脈瘤による反復性脳出血で発症。産後脳出血患者における早期認識の重要性を強調。
pmid-33130006.summary_en: 16-year-old postpartum patient with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with recurrent intracranial hemorrhage from multiple oncotic aneurysms. β-hCG: 356,684 mIU. Chemotherapy with etoposide-based regimen initiated. Case emphasizes early recognition importance in postpartum patients.

pmid-33135391.summary_ja: プラチナ抵抗性のGCTに対し、低メチル化薬グアデシタビンとシスプラチンを併用した第I相試験。前治療歴の多い14例が登録された。MTDは30 mg/m²と100 mg/m²に決定された。全体の奏効率は23%、臨床的有用率は46%であった。
pmid-33135391.summary_en: Phase I trial of guadecitabine (hypomethylating agent) combined with cisplatin in platinum-refractory GCT. 14 heavily pretreated patients enrolled. MTD established at 30 mg/m² guadecitabine + 100 mg/m² cisplatin. 23% overall response rate with 46% clinical benefit rate.

pmid-33136584.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢成分を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後切除標本55例を解析した。血管新生性特徴を有する症例は、血管新生性間質を伴う奇形腫、血管新生性間葉系腫瘍(VMT)、血管肉腫に分類された。VMTは肉腫および血液悪性腫瘍のリスク上昇と関連していた。
pmid-33136584.summary_en: Analysis of 55 postchemotherapy mediastinal GCTs with yolk sac components showing vasculogenic features. Cases classified as teratoma with vasculogenic stroma, vasculogenic mesenchymal tumor (VMT), or angiosarcoma. VMT associated with increased sarcoma and hematologic malignancy risk.

pmid-33137349.summary_ja: 精巣温存手術の検討で28症例のうち14症例で完了。単側性腫瘤での成功率41%、両側性/単独精巣疾患では83%。中央値12.2ヶ月で96%が無病生存。
pmid-33137349.summary_en: Testis-sparing surgery (TSS) in 28 patients with small benign masses or tumors in solitary/bilateral testes. Completed in 14 cases. Success rate 41% for unilateral masses, 83% for bilateral/solitary disease. At median 12.2 months follow-up, 96% disease-free.

pmid-33138660.summary_ja: 再発・白金耐性精巣GCTの新規治療法に関する文献レビュー。高容量化学療法と自己幹細胞移植に有望な成績があり、臨床試験への患者登録が推奨される。
pmid-33138660.summary_en: Comprehensive review of novel therapies for relapsed/refractory testicular GCTs (1964-2020). Examines molecularly targeted therapies and epigenetic approaches. High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplant shows promise; targeted therapy efficacy remains unclear.

pmid-33139148.summary_ja: 混合性悪性精巣GCTの化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清についての23症例の後ろ向き解析。両側性テンプレートは片側性より周術期転帰が悪かったが、腫瘍学的転帰は同等。
pmid-33139148.summary_en: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for mixed malignant testicular GCTs post-chemotherapy. Study of 23 patients comparing bilateral vs unilateral template approaches. Unilateral approach showed better perioperative outcomes with similar oncologic results.

pmid-33139212.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛疾患の最稀な亜型（PSTT、ETT）の診断と治療についての総説。化学療法耐性が主要な課題として強調される。
pmid-33139212.summary_en: Review of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), the rarest gestational trophoblastic disease subtypes. Slow-growing tumors occurring months to years after pregnancy; hysterectomy is primary treatment, but chemotherapy resistance remains a major clinical challenge.

pmid-33141029.summary_ja: 小児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の化学療法中の異常な臨床経過。再発・転移を認め後腹膜リンパ節郭清と局所再発切除を施行。
pmid-33141029.summary_en: Case report of pediatric testicular yolk sac tumor with unusual presentation, local relapse, and metastasis despite chemotherapy. Subsequently underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and local recurrence excision.

pmid-33142349.summary_ja: 卵巣胚性がん、非妊娠性絨毛がん、悪性混合性GCT13例の超音波像を検討。大型の不均一性実質腫瘤と散在性小嚢胞が特徴。
pmid-33142349.summary_en: Retrospective multicenter ultrasound study of 13 rare malignant ovarian GCTs: 1 embryonal carcinoma, 5 non-gestational choriocarcinomas, 7 malignant mixed tumors. Typical appearance: large solid tumor with inhomogeneous echogenicity and dispersed small cystic areas in young women.

pmid-33144230.summary_ja: 小児卵巣病変222例を検討。GCT（奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍）が最多新生物。CT所見と腫瘍マーカーでGCT診断に有用。
pmid-33144230.summary_en: Series of 222 pediatric ovarian lesions with 160 neoplastic cases. GCTs (teratomas, yolk sac tumors) were most common neoplasms. Fat and calcification on CT are highly specific for GCTs; elevation of AFP/hCG indicates GCT diagnosis.

pmid-33158661.summary_ja: 100例の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、血漿中のmicroRNA-375およびmiR-371を奇形腫と活動性胚細胞悪性腫瘍の鑑別マーカーとして評価した前向き多施設研究。統合的なmiR371-miR375評価は、発見コホートでAUC 0.95を達成した。
pmid-33158661.summary_en: Prospective multicenter study evaluating plasma microRNA-375 and miR-371 as biomarkers to identify teratoma and distinguish from active germ cell malignancy in 100 GCT patients. Integrated miR371-miR375 evaluation achieved 0.95 AUC in discovery cohort.

pmid-33172924.summary_ja: 妊娠中に付属器腫瘤を有する113例の後方視的研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍や絨毛癌を含む160個の腫瘍性病変を同定した。絨毛癌および転移性腫瘍の症例で新生児死亡が2例発生した。妊娠中の管理指針としてIOTA超音波分類が有用である。
pmid-33172924.summary_en: Retrospective study of 113 pregnant women with adnexal masses identifying 160 neoplastic lesions including GCTs and choriocarcinoma. Two neonatal deaths occurred with choriocarcinoma and metastatic tumors. IOTA ultrasound classification helps guide management during pregnancy.

pmid-33174648.summary_ja: 眼窩下縁から発生する胎児性顔面奇形腫の出生前診断症例。良好な妊娠経過と正常新生児分娩を達成。
pmid-33174648.summary_en: Prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of isolated facial teratoma presenting as an avascular ossified lesion at the orbital rim. Term delivery by cesarean section resulted in healthy neonate with no fetal compromise.

pmid-33176305.summary_ja: 未熟精巣奇形腫の小児23例の後方視的研究(中央値6か月)。精巣温存腫瘍核出術(13例)と精巣摘除術(10例)を比較した。追跡された19例は全例で無病生存が得られ、若年児では良性の性質を示唆している。
pmid-33176305.summary_en: Retrospective study of 23 children with immature testicular teratoma (median age 6 months). Testis-preserving tumor enucleation (13 cases) versus orchiectomy (10 cases); all 19 followed patients achieved disease-free survival without recurrence, suggesting benign characteristics in young children.

pmid-33176993.summary_ja: HIV陽性患者における妊娠絨毛腫瘍の臨床的特徴に関する総説。GTDの治癒率は高いが、HIV関連因子が治療成績と生存率に影響。
pmid-33176993.summary_en: Review of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm in HIV-positive patients. While GTD has high cure rates (~90%), HIV-related factors including low CD4 counts and extensive metastatic disease significantly compromise treatment outcomes and survival.

pmid-33179558.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛がん細胞の直流電界への応答を検討。電界刺激によりG2/M期停止と細胞移動・増殖関連信号伝達経路の変化を誘導。
pmid-33179558.summary_en: In vitro study investigating effects of direct current electric fields on human choriocarcinoma cell migration, proliferation, and gene expression. Electric field stimulation induced G2/M arrest and altered ErbB and HIF-1 signaling pathways regulating cell behavior.

pmid-33180596.summary_ja: 化学療法後の後大静脈周囲郭清を受けた精巣がん患者211例の手術成績を解析した。組織学的には奇形腫が72%、壊死が15.2%、活動性癌が8.1%であった。経腹/経横隔膜アプローチは合併症と在院日数を減少させた。
pmid-33180596.summary_en: Surgical outcomes analysis of 211 testicular cancer patients undergoing postchemotherapy retrocrural dissection. Histology: 72% teratoma, 15.2% necrosis, 8.1% active cancer. Transabdominal/transdiaphragmatic approach reduced complications and hospitalization length.

pmid-33186060.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍を組織型で分類し、画像と病理の対比を強調した総説。奇形腫を含むGCTの診断アルゴリズムを含む。
pmid-33186060.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian neoplasms categorized by histopathology (epithelial, germ cell, sex cord-stromal) with imaging-pathology correlation. Includes detailed discussion of teratomas and other GCTs with diagnostic algorithms.

pmid-33189529.summary_ja: 3,834例の精巣胚細胞がん患者を対象としたコホート研究であり、対側精巣がんの発生率と特徴を解析した。累積発生率は5年で2%、14年で4%であった。若年齢は危険因子であり、化学療法は異時性がんのリスクを低下させた。
pmid-33189529.summary_en: Large cohort study of 3,834 germ cell testicular cancer patients analyzing incidence and characteristics of contralateral testis cancer. Cumulative incidence 2% at 5 years and 4% at 14 years; younger age increased risk while chemotherapy reduced metachronous cancer risk.

pmid-33189896.summary_ja: 卵巣非妊娠性絨毛がんの15歳女児。生殖温存手術と化学療法により5年以上の無病生存を達成。若年患者への生殖温存の重要性を示す。
pmid-33189896.summary_en: Case of 15-year-old girl with nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma (stage IIA) treated with fertility-sparing surgery and chemotherapy. Achieved disease-free survival over 5 years, demonstrating feasibility of conservative surgery in young GCT patients.

pmid-33197418.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛疾患に対する腹腔鏡下子宮全摘術に拡張搔爬を組み合わせた低侵襲手術。出血量低減と開腹術回避により術後回復を改善。
pmid-33197418.summary_en: Describes a novel minimally invasive laparoscopic approach for hysterectomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Combination of laparoscopic vascular transection with dilation and evacuation allowed intact uterine removal via vagina, reducing blood loss and avoiding laparotomy.

pmid-33197962.summary_ja: 子宮体部由来の未熟奇形腫の報告例中最年少の11歳女児症例。外科治療と化学療法後2年以上の無病生存を達成。
pmid-33197962.summary_en: Case report of immature teratoma arising from the uterine corpus in an 11-year-old girl, the youngest reported case of primary uterine immature teratoma. Disease-free survival achieved over 2 years following surgery and chemotherapy.

pmid-33200255.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの感度の高いバイオマーカーmiR-371a-3pが、精巣リンパ腫や性腺間質腫瘍では上昇しないことを確認。GCT診断の特異性を実証。
pmid-33200255.summary_en: Demonstrates that serum microRNA-371a-3p, a sensitive GCT biomarker, is not elevated in non-germ cell testicular tumors, confirming its specificity for distinguishing GCTs from lymphomas and gonadal stromal tumors.

pmid-33204644.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精純性成熟奇形腫の患者が化学療法中に胚性癌への悪性転化を起こし、腎転移を認めた症例。精巣奇形腫の悪性への変化と治療中の放射線学的監視の重要性を示す。
pmid-33204644.summary_en: A 32-year-old male with stage I pure testicular teratoma developed embryonal carcinoma metastasis to the kidney during chemotherapy, mimicking a complex cyst. This case highlights the malignant potential of pure testicular teratoma and the importance of radiological monitoring during GCT treatment.

pmid-33216164.summary_ja: 中国の6例の患者を対象とした卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDAR脳炎の症例集積である。典型的な症状として精神病症状、記憶障害、痙攣が認められた。免疫療法と腫瘍の外科的摘出により死亡例なく良好な転帰が得られたが、経過観察中に2例で再発がみられた。
pmid-33216164.summary_en: Case series of 6 Chinese patients with ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Typical presentations included psychosis, memory disorders, seizures. Immunotherapy and surgical tumor removal achieved good outcomes with no mortality; 2 recurrences in follow-up.

pmid-33219741.summary_ja: 小児の悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍45例(年齢中央値1.6歳)の前向き解析である。最も多い組織型は卵黄嚢腫瘍(60%)と奇形腫であった。5年全生存期間は95%、無イベント生存期間は69%であったが、31%が再発を経験した。
pmid-33219741.summary_en: Prospective analysis of 45 malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors in children (median age 1.6 years). Most frequent histologies were yolk sac tumor (60%) and teratoma. 5-year overall survival 95% with 69% event-free survival despite 31% relapse rate.

pmid-33220811.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の肝転移に関する外科的レビューである。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の第一選択治療は化学療法であり、肝切除の有効性は組織型と化学療法への反応に依存する。
pmid-33220811.summary_en: Surgical review of liver metastases from genitourinary malignancies including germ cell tumors. Chemotherapy is first-line for metastatic GCTs; liver resection effectiveness depends on histology and response to chemotherapy.

pmid-33222481.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の診断において、超音波内視鏡下穿刺吸引法の臨床的有用性を示している。
pmid-33222481.summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Demonstrates clinical utility of endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration for diagnosing metastatic germ cell tumors.

pmid-33242216.summary_ja: 79例の出生前診断胎児奇形腫の単一施設研究。仙骨部(59.5%)、頸部(20.2%)、咽頭部(7.6%)が最多。早産率72.7%と高く、羊水過多と心機能障害が主要合併症。
pmid-33242216.summary_en: Retrospective single-center study of 79 prenatally diagnosed fetal teratomas. Most common locations were sacrococcygeal (59.5%), neck (20.2%), and oropharynx (7.6%). High preterm birth rate (72.7%) and complications including polyhydramnios and cardiac compromise required careful prenatal monitoring.

pmid-33272644.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者の腹腔鏡下子宮全摘除術と開腹術の比較。完全胞状奇胎、侵襲性胞状奇胎、絨毛癌などを含む39例の検討で、低侵襲手術は出血量減少と入院期間短縮の利点を示している。
pmid-33272644.summary_en: Comparison of minimally invasive and open hysterectomy for gestational trophoblastic disease management. Study of 39 patients with complete moles, invasive moles, choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors shows similar oncologic outcomes with MIH benefits of reduced blood loss and shorter hospital stay.

pmid-33278425.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞を用いたLOXL1-AS1 lncRNAとmiR-515-5pの相互作用に関する研究。NF-κB経路を介して絨毛癌細胞の増殖と遊走を制御するメカニズムを明らかにしている。
pmid-33278425.summary_en: Molecular mechanism study of choriocarcinoma cells examining LOXL1-AS1 lncRNA regulation of miR-515-5p. Research demonstrates how this axis controls choriocarcinoma cell proliferation and migration through NF-κB signaling pathway modulation.

pmid-33283628.summary_ja: 白金製剤抵抗性の非セミノーマ性精巣GCT患者に、救援療法としてニボルマブを投与した症例報告。重大な毒性なく13か月間病勢が安定した。治療抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍における免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の潜在的な有益性が示された。
pmid-33283628.summary_en: Case report of platinum-refractory nonseminomatous testicular GCT patient treated with nivolumab as salvage therapy. Patient achieved stable disease for 13 months without significant toxicity, demonstrating potential benefit of immune checkpoint inhibitors in treatment-resistant germ cell tumors.

pmid-33284192.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍100例の報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍(91%)、ディスジャーミノーマ(61%)、未熟奇形腫(58%)が主要な成分であった。ディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の組み合わせ(25%)および未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の組み合わせ(20%)が多く、胚様体が成分形成に寄与していた。
pmid-33284192.summary_en: Largest series of 100 ovarian malignant mixed germ cell tumors describes composition including yolk sac tumor (91%), dysgerminoma (61%), and immature teratoma (58%). Common patterns included dysgerminoma-yolk sac tumor (25%) and immature teratoma-yolk sac tumor (20%), with embryoid bodies frequently contributing to component development.

pmid-33285049.summary_ja: 14例の男性原発性絨毛癌の臨床経験報告。精巣（50%）と縦隔（43%）が主な原発部位。化学療法抵抗性例では免疫チェックポイント阻害薬が救済療法の選択肢。
pmid-33285049.summary_en: Retrospective study of 14 male patients with primary choriocarcinoma (1996-2020). Median age 33 years. Primary sites: testis (50%), mediastinum (43%), brain (7%). Lungs most common metastatic site (79%). Eight of 12 patients achieved objective response to cytotoxic chemotherapy; discusses poor prognosis and salvage therapy with checkpoint inhibitors.

pmid-33288479.summary_ja: 臨床病期I期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者151例を監視中の血清miR-371a-3pを検討した。精巣摘除術後のmiR-371a-3pは再発と関連しなかった。一方、再発時には従来のマーカーが正常でも94.1%で上昇していた。早期再発マーカーとしての可能性があり、前向き研究による検証が必要である。
pmid-33288479.summary_en: Study of serum miR-371a-3p biomarker in 151 clinical stage I testicular GCT patients on surveillance. Postorchiectomy miR-371a-3p not associated with relapse; however, miR-371a-3p elevated at relapse in 94.1% despite normal conventional markers. Suggests potential as early relapse detection marker warranting prospective evaluation.

pmid-33290506.summary_ja: 精巣由来のPNET（体性型primitive neuroectodermal tumors）の免疫組織化学的特性。SOX11は未分化成分で陽性。神経・膠細胞分化の特性を記載。
pmid-33290506.summary_en: Study of 13 testicular germ cell tumor-derived primitive neuroectodermal tumors (PNETs) examining morphologic and immunophenotypic features including neuronal and glial differentiation. SOX11 positive in undifferentiated component; GFAP and S100 more frequent in differentiated areas. Provides diagnostic immunohistochemical markers.

pmid-33294376.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ混合GCTと横紋筋肉腫を伴う19歳男性の症例。体性型悪性腫瘍の合併は予後不良。
pmid-33294376.summary_en: Case report of 19-year-old boy with testicular non-seminomatous mixed germ cell tumor combined with somatic malignancy (rhabdomyosarcoma) and retroperitoneal metastatic mass. Treated with radical orchiectomy followed by chemotherapy. Patient's condition deteriorated despite treatment, illustrating poor prognosis of this rare combination.

pmid-33294378.summary_ja: 6ヶ月女児の腎臓未分化奇形腫の症例報告。文献4番目の症例。稀な異所性胚細胞腫瘍。
pmid-33294378.summary_en: Rare case report of immature renal teratoma in 6-month-old female patient. Only fourth case reported in literature. Discusses pathology and reviews relevant literature on this unusual extragonadal teratoma location.

pmid-33296263.summary_ja: 48例の純粋卵巣未分化奇形腫の臨床病理学的特性と術後成績の研究。Grade IIIで再発多い。温存手術が87.5%。良性・悪性再発の予後が異なる。
pmid-33296263.summary_en: Turkish multicenter study of 48 patients with pure ovarian immature teratoma (age 15-39 years). Most (83%) had stage I disease. Grade III tumors showed higher recurrence. Fertility-sparing surgery in 87.5%. Benign recurrence (10.4%) more common than malignant (4.1%). Treatment based on histologic grade and stage.

pmid-33300248.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟囊胞性奇形腫の悪性転化（MTMCT）のPDXモデルと細胞株NOSCC1の確立。扁平上皮癌への転化を示す。新規治療開発のための重要なツール。
pmid-33300248.summary_en: Establishment of patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model and new cell line (NOSCC1) from malignant transformation of mature cystic ovarian teratoma (MTMCT). Patient was 32-year-old with squamous cell carcinoma transformation. PDX model successfully engrafted and maintained histology. Important tool for preclinical drug screening and carcinogenic mechanism studies.

pmid-33308971.summary_ja: 化学療法後1cm未満の後腹膜残存腫瘤を持つ39例のメタスタティックNSGCT患者の経過観察研究。測定軸による再発予測の差を検討。短軸を基準とした経過観察が有効。
pmid-33308971.summary_en: Retrospective study of 39 good-risk metastatic NSGCT patients with postchemotherapy residual retroperitoneal mass <1.0 cm on surveillance. Compares measurement axes (transaxial short, transaxial long, craniocaudal). Demonstrates surveillance effective when using transaxial short axis, avoiding unnecessary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-33314803.summary_ja: 63例のGCT患者におけるBEP化学療法前の炎症関連スコアの予後的意義を比較。Glasgow prognostic scoreが全生存期間と無増悪生存期間の最良の予測因子。
pmid-33314803.summary_en: Comparison of inflammation-based prognostic scoring systems in 63 GCT patients receiving BEP chemotherapy. Evaluates Glasgow prognostic score, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio, and others. Glasgow prognostic score demonstrated best predictive ability for overall and progression-free survival.

pmid-33316416.summary_ja: 138例の小児卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍のCOG多施設研究。Yolk sac tumor、embryonal carcinoma、choriocarcinomaを含む。術前マーカー測定と完全ステージング施行の重要性。
pmid-33316416.summary_en: Multicenter COG study of 138 pediatric female patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma). Describes imaging appearance and frequency of associated benign teratoma elements. Mixed cystic-solid appearance noted in 83.5%; emphasizes importance of preoperative tumor markers.

pmid-33319858.summary_ja: 219例の精巣非セミノーマGCTにおける転移予測因子の病理学的分析。リンパ管侵襲、胚細胞成分率、rete testis浸潤が独立した予測因子。TNM分類改定に有用。
pmid-33319858.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 219 non-seminomatous testicular GCT cases identifying pathological predictors of metastatic disease at presentation. Lymphovascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma percentage, stromal rete testis invasion, and tumor size are independent predictors. Provides guidance for TNM staging system refinement.

pmid-33323883.summary_ja: 新生児の仙骨尾骨未分化奇形腫がリンパ節転移を伴った初例。化学療法後に未分化から成熟型への組織学的転化を示す。
pmid-33323883.summary_en: First reported case of immature sacrococcygeal teratoma with inguinal lymph node metastasis in neonate. Demonstrates remarkable histologic transformation from immature teratoma to mature teratoma following chemotherapy. Illustrates unique biological behavior of immature teratomas with treatment-induced differentiation.

pmid-33328389.summary_ja: growing teratoma syndrome（GTS）の21症例を集積した症例集積研究で、臨床的特徴と治療成績を報告している。12例が手術を受け、再発の有無にばらつきがみられた。切除不能の9例は化学療法またはインターフェロンで治療され、一部は自家造血幹細胞移植を受けて有望な奏効が得られた。手術は依然として治療の主体である。
pmid-33328389.summary_en: Case series of 21 growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) patients reporting clinical characteristics and treatment outcomes. Twelve underwent surgery with variable recurrence. Nine with unresectable disease treated with chemotherapy or interferon; some underwent autologous stem cell transplantation with promising responses. Surgery remains mainstay of treatment.

pmid-33333524.summary_ja: 317例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における血栓塞栓症の発症と危険因子の分析。進行期と中心静脈アクセス使用が独立した危険因子。合併症対策の重要性。
pmid-33333524.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 317 testicular GCT patients identifying thromboembolic events (TEE) in 7.3% of cases. Advanced clinical stage and central venous access devices identified as independent risk factors. Emphasizes importance of thrombosis awareness and monitoring in GCT patient management.

pmid-33333530.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者172例を対象に、精巣静脈血と末梢血の腫瘍マーカー（β-HCG、AFP、PLAP、LDH）を比較した研究。精巣静脈血の値は有意に高いものの、病期や再発確率の評価において末梢血の値を上回る臨床的利点はなかった。追跡期間の中央値は9.9年である。
pmid-33333530.summary_en: Study comparing tumor markers (β-HCG, AFP, PLAP, LDH) from testicular vein versus peripheral blood in 172 testicular cancer patients with 9.9-year median follow-up. Finds testicular vein markers significantly higher but provide no additional clinical advantage for assessing tumor stage or recurrence probability over peripheral markers.

pmid-33337613.summary_ja: 絨毛癌、PSTT、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の治療に関する包括的総説。従来の化学療法、新たな免疫チェックポイント阻害薬療法、予後因子、2020年代のGTN管理におけるサーベイランス戦略を論じている。
pmid-33337613.summary_en: Comprehensive review of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) treatment including choriocarcinoma, PSTT, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors. Discusses conventional chemotherapy, emerging checkpoint inhibitor therapy, prognostic factors, and surveillance strategies for GTN management in the 2020s.

pmid-33345433.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者のCOVID-19罹患時における化学療法継続の判断に関する症例報告。ウイルス感染と化学療法の継続という臨床的ジレンマを提示。
pmid-33345433.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal germ cell tumor patient who developed COVID-19 during BEP chemotherapy. Discusses clinical decision-making regarding continuation versus deferral of chemotherapy in active viral infection. Addresses practical management challenge of balancing cancer treatment with infectious disease risk in GCT patients.

pmid-33353868.summary_ja: 10134例のセミノーマT1患者を対象に、3cm境界値の臨床的有用性を検討した研究。転移予測には有用でないが、補助療法選択に関連し、過剰治療の可能性を指摘した。
pmid-33353868.summary_en: Retrospective study of 10,134 pT1 seminoma patients evaluating clinical utility of the 3 cm AJCC cutoff for pT1a/b subclassification. Found the cutoff does not predict metastatic recurrence but correlates with adjuvant therapy receipt.

pmid-33356420.summary_ja: 5620人の精巣GCT患者を対象とした20年間の追跡研究。対側精巣癌の発生率は4.0%で、化学療法後は3.2%と低かった。複数のシスプラチンサイクルで防止効果が増大した。
pmid-33356420.summary_en: Population-based Norwegian cohort study of 5,620 men with first testicular germ cell cancer, tracking metachronous second TC over median 18 years. Second TC incidence was 4.0%, significantly reduced after chemotherapy versus surgery alone.

pmid-33356941.summary_ja: 44例の新生児仙尾部奇形腫の20年臨床成績。77%が嚢胞性で97.7%が成熟型。外科的完全切除で再発なし；嚢胞性形態と成熟組織学が良好予後因子であった。
pmid-33356941.summary_en: Retrospective 20-year case series of 44 neonates with sacrococcygeal teratoma (extragonadal GCT). 77% were cystic; 97.7% showed mature histology. All managed by total excision with no recurrence at 12-month follow-up.

pmid-33360007.summary_ja: 人間絨毛膜癌細胞株BeWoを用いた研究。p57(KIP2)発現が細胞増殖・浸潤を低下させ、合胞体化を促進し、シンシチン-2発現を増加させた。
pmid-33360007.summary_en: Basic research on human choriocarcinoma (BeWo) cell line demonstrating that p57(KIP2) expression reduces proliferation and invasion while inducing syncytialization. p57(KIP2) upregulated Syncytin-2, associated with trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-33364174.summary_ja: 腎細胞癌に対する腎摘除術の際に傍大動脈リンパ節から転移性セミノーマ(胚細胞腫瘍)が発見された症例報告。精巣に原発巣を認めない精巣がんの非典型的な提示例を示している。
pmid-33364174.summary_en: Case report of metastatic seminoma (germ cell tumor) discovered in para-aortic lymph nodes during nephrectomy for renal cell carcinoma. Highlights the atypical presentation of testicular cancer without primary testicular involvement.

pmid-33364180.summary_ja: 下垂体ACTH産生細胞を含む10cm成熟卵巣奇形腫による副腎皮質機能亢進症の症例。卵巣捻転を合併し手術治療を実施した。
pmid-33364180.summary_en: Case report of a 22-year-old woman with mature ovarian teratoma (10 cm) presenting with signs of cortisol excess due to ACTH-secreting pituitary tissue within the teratoma. Presented with ovarian torsion requiring surgical management.

pmid-33377559.summary_ja: 小児卵巣奇形腫25例と脊髄外転移3例の単一核酸多型解析。5パターンのCN-LOH検出され、第一減数分裂失敗が最多で、奇形腫発生メカニズムを提示した。
pmid-33377559.summary_en: Cytogenetic study of 25 primary ovarian teratomas and 3 extraovarian deposits in children using SNP array and karyotype analysis. Identified five patterns of copy neutral loss of heterozygosity (CN-LOH) reflecting various meiotic errors.

pmid-33384137.summary_ja: 妊娠性疾患管理のフランス語版臨床ガイドライン。良性から悪性疾患までの診断・治療と多学科がんチーム管理を推奨した。
pmid-33384137.summary_en: French-language clinical guideline for diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic diseases, equivalent to guideline No. 408, covering benign to malignant entities and recommendations for multidisciplinary cancer care.

pmid-33384141.summary_ja: 妊娠性疾患（胞状奇胎、侵襲性胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛膜癌）の診断と治療に関する包括的ガイドライン。外科的・薬物療法、多学科チームによる管理、中央集約型ケアを推奨した。
pmid-33384141.summary_en: Comprehensive clinical guideline for diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic diseases, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and gestational choriocarcinoma. Covers surgical/medical management, follow-up protocols, and recommendations for centralized care and multidisciplinary approach.

pmid-33384179.summary_ja: 高hCG血症を示した若年女性ドナーから腎移植および肝移植患者へ絨毛膜癌が伝播した稀な症例。転移癌により両患者が死亡し、ドナーhCGスクリーニングの重要性を強調した。
pmid-33384179.summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma transmission from a 17-year-old female donor to two recipients (kidney and liver transplant) with high hCG levels. Both recipients developed metastatic disease and died, highlighting the need for hCG screening before donation.

pmid-33386645.summary_ja: 気道閉塞性の頭頸部奇形腫11例のEXIT手術適応と周産期成績に関する研究。新生児死亡率18%、生存者の33%が退院時に気管切開を要した。
pmid-33386645.summary_en: Retrospective study of EXIT (ex utero intrapartum treatment) procedures for 11 children with airway-obstructing head and neck teratomas. Nine of 11 had associated polyhydramnios; neonatal mortality was 18% with 33% of survivors requiring tracheostomy.

pmid-33388510.summary_ja: 嚢胞性リンパ管腫と誤診された2歳男児の頸部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（性腺外胚細胞腫瘍）の症例報告。気道閉塞症状を呈した。完全な外科的切除により、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫の成分が確認された。
pmid-33388510.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma of the neck (extragonadal GCT) in a 2-year-old boy presenting with airway obstruction, initially misdiagnosed as cystic hygroma. Complete surgical resection confirmed histological diagnosis with mature teratoma elements.

pmid-33390789.summary_ja: 絨毛膜癌（GTD）におけるpl-CSAの発癌・転移への役割に関する基礎研究。ChSy-2ノックアウトはpl-CSAを減少させ、細胞増殖・浸潤と転移を阻害した。
pmid-33390789.summary_en: Basic research on choriocarcinoma (gestational trophoblastic disease) investigating the role of placental-like chondroitin sulfate A (pl-CSA) in tumorigenesis and metastasis. ChSy-2 knockout reduced pl-CSA and inhibited cell proliferation, invasion, and metastasis in vitro and in vivo.

pmid-33394011.summary_ja: ジェルミノーマ（GCT）を含む中枢神経系腫瘍患者における卵巣組織凍結保存と移植の安全性を評価した研究。凍結卵巣組織での悪性細胞の種子播きは検出されなかった。
pmid-33394011.summary_en: Study evaluating safety of ovarian tissue cryopreservation and transplantation in cancer patients including those with CNS germinomas. Assessed whether malignant cells seeded in frozen-thawed ovarian tissue and found no evidence of malignancy reseeding.

pmid-33394097.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫（最も一般的な卵巣GCT）の包括的総説。成熟型、未成熟型、単系統性型の疫学、組織学、画像所見、臨床管理について詳述した。
pmid-33394097.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian teratomas (most common germ cell tumors of the ovary). Discusses epidemiology, histopathology, clinical presentation, imaging features of mature, immature, and monodermal subtypes, and management strategies.

pmid-33404722.summary_ja: 髄膜瘤と誤診された新生児脊髄外成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。外科的完全切除と正確な病理診断により再発リスクを軽減する重要性を強調した。
pmid-33404722.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma in a newborn initially presenting as meningomyelocele. Complete surgical resection confirmed histopathology with mature elements from ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal germ layers.

pmid-33407043.summary_ja: ネフローゼ症候群を呈した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告。ループス様糸球体腎炎を示し、SLE誤診による診断の遅れを強調した。
pmid-33407043.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT, gestational trophoblastic disease) presenting with lupus-like paraneoplastic nephritis years after symptom onset. Describes diagnostic challenges when PSTT is misdiagnosed as systemic lupus erythematosus.

pmid-33411594.summary_ja: 拡散強調画像によるADC値を用いて、正常精巣、潜伏精巣、セミノーマを鑑別する研究。各グループ間でADC値に有意差があり、セミノーマの診断と臨床意思決定の支援における有用性が示唆された。
pmid-33411594.summary_en: Study evaluating apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values on diffusion-weighted imaging to differentiate normal testes, cryptorchid testes, and seminomas in postpubertal patients. ADC values showed statistically significant differences with clinical utility for seminoma diagnosis.

pmid-33412409.summary_ja: 44歳女性の稀な脾臓成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。左側腹部痛で発症。CTで脾実質内の腫瘤を確認。脾臓摘出術で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定。精巣外奇形腫、特に脾臓発生は稀な腫瘍。
pmid-33412409.summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature splenic cystic teratoma in a 44-year-old woman presenting with left flank abdominal pain. CT imaging identified an intraparenchymal hypodense splenic mass with dense areas. Splenectomy was performed and histopathological analysis confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Treatment decisions should consider symptom status.

pmid-33412555.summary_ja: 成人男性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療に関するドイツの臨床診療ガイドライン。疫学、分類、診断、予後、生殖能温存、限局期治療を含む161の臨床推奨。42名の専門家による根拠に基づいた系統的推奨を提示。
pmid-33412555.summary_en: This German evidence-based clinical guideline addresses diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of testicular germ cell tumors in adults. Part I covers epidemiology, classification, diagnostics, prognosis, fertility preservation, and treatment for localized stages. An interdisciplinary panel of 42 experts developed 161 clinical recommendations based on systematic literature review.

pmid-33416104.summary_ja: 未成熟卵巣奇形腫における長鎖非翻訳RNALINC00324の役割を検討。LINC00324はmiR-214-5pスポンジとして機能し、CDK6、CCND1、MDM2、MDM4の発現を脱抑制して細胞増殖を促進。LINC00324の枯渇は増殖を低下。
pmid-33416104.summary_en: This molecular study investigated LINC00324 long non-coding RNA in immature ovarian teratocarcinoma as a competing endogenous RNA. LINC00324 upregulation in IOT tissues promoted cell proliferation by acting as a miR-214-5p sponge, derepressing CDK6, CCND1, MDM2, and MDM4. LINC00324 depletion reduced proliferation and increased apoptosis.

pmid-33419745.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の高位精巣摘出術と化学療法から5年後、監視CTで腹腔内軟部腫瘍を認めた症例。摘出組織の病理組織学的検査では胚細胞腫瘍再発ではなく腹腔内デスモイド。治療後経過観察における鑑別診断の重要性。
pmid-33419745.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old man initially treated for testicular germ cell tumor with orchidectomy and chemotherapy. Five years later, surveillance CT revealed a new soft tissue lesion, raising concern for GCT recurrence. Excision and histopathological analysis revealed an intra-abdominal desmoid rather than GCT recurrence.

pmid-33421136.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍頸部転移患者68例の選択的頸部リンパ節郭清の症例シリーズ。82.2%がIII期、化学療法後の郭清。標本の83.8%で成熟奇形腫。2年頸部無再発生存率83%、全生存率93%。
pmid-33421136.summary_en: This retrospective case series of 68 patients examined selective neck dissection for cervical metastases of nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Most patients (82.2%) had stage III disease and underwent primary chemotherapy. Cervical specimens predominantly showed mature teratoma (83.8%). Two-year cervical recurrence-free survival was 83%, with overall survival 93%.

pmid-33422446.summary_ja: 前悪性の部分胞状奇胎および全胞状奇胎、ならびに悪性の侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)を扱ったレビュー論文である。妊娠初期の超音波検査の導入により発見が早期化したことを述べている。診断には超音波検査、血清hCG、およびCT/MRI/PETによる画像検査が用いられる。
pmid-33422446.summary_en: This review article covers gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including premalignant partial and complete hydatidiform moles and malignant invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental-site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Clinical presentation changed to earlier detection after first trimester ultrasound introduction. Diagnosis utilizes ultrasound, serum hCG, and CT/MRI/PET imaging.

pmid-33423934.summary_ja: SEERデータベースに登録された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者8,573例を対象に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と生存率における社会人口学的格差を解析したものである。最低社会経済的地位の五分位および病期II疾患の黒人患者は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受ける可能性が有意に低かった。社会経済的地位の低い患者および黒人患者では、がん特異的死亡率が高かった。
pmid-33423934.summary_en: This SEER database analysis of 8,573 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients examined sociodemographic disparities in retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and survival. Lowest SES quintile and Black patients with stage II disease were significantly less likely to receive RPLND. Low SES and Black patients showed higher cancer-specific mortality.

pmid-33427916.summary_ja: 中国人の卵巣奇形腫患者3,835例を対象とした12年間の横断研究であり、側方分布と臨床的特徴を検討している。右側の良性奇形腫(53.24%)は左側(46.76%)より多かった(P<0.001)。左側の奇形腫は再発率が高かった(55%対45%)。
pmid-33427916.summary_en: This 12-year cross-sectional study of 3,835 Chinese patients with ovarian teratoma examined lateral distribution and clinical characteristics. Right-sided benign teratomas (53.24%) were more common than left-sided (46.76%, P<0.001). Left-sided teratomas showed higher recurrence rates (55% vs. 45%).

pmid-33428791.summary_ja: 化学療法後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者37例の精巣切除標本の組織学的反応を分析。48.6%で残存病変、3例で生細胞腫瘍、15例で成熟奇形腫。化学療法後の精巣腫瘍サイズと生細胞腫瘍の存在が相関。
pmid-33428791.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed post-chemotherapy orchidectomy specimens in 37 testicular germ cell tumor patients following chemotherapy. Of 37 post-chemotherapy orchidectomies, 48.6% showed residual disease: 3 with viable tumor and 15 with mature teratoma. Post-chemotherapy testicular tumor size correlated with residual viable tumor presence.

pmid-33430117.summary_ja: セミノーマ細胞株を用いたPTTG1の浸潤性への役割の検討。核PTTG1は侵襲表型と正相関し、MMP-2活性化を介して細胞遊走と浸潤を増加。Atlasデータベース分析でセミノーマでの核PTTG1局在と高いMMP-2レベルを確認。予後因子としての可能性を示唆。
pmid-33430117.summary_en: This study investigated PTTG1's role in seminoma invasiveness using three seminoma cell lines. Nuclear PTTG1 localization was positively correlated with aggressive phenotype and increased cell migration/invasion through MMP-2 activation. Atlas database analysis showed nuclear PTTG1 localization in seminomas with significantly higher MMP-2 levels, supporting PTTG1 as potential prognostic marker.

pmid-33430420.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を用いた新規DNMT阻害薬MLo1302の評価。ナノモル範囲のIC50と細胞毒性を示し、シスプラチン耐性株でも効果的。カスパーゼ活性化によるアポトーシス誘導と細胞周期停止を引き起こし、より低毒性のTGCT治療戦略の可能性を示唆。
pmid-33430420.summary_en: This study evaluated a novel DNA methyltransferase inhibitor, MLo1302, in testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. MLo1302 demonstrated potent cytotoxicity with nanomolar IC50 values and reduced cell viability including in cisplatin-resistant cells. The compound induced apoptosis through caspase activation and caused cell cycle arrest, suggesting potential for less toxic TGCT treatment strategies.

pmid-33433434.summary_ja: 38歳女性の卵巣における線維腫と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の衝突腫瘍を報告。15×12×7cmの腫瘤が線維腫成分を含んだ。衝突腫瘍は同一臓器における2つの組織学的に異なる腫瘍で、成分の同定が臨床管理に重要。
pmid-33433434.summary_en: This case report describes a collision tumor of the ovary comprising a fibroma and mature cystic teratoma in a 38-year-old woman. The 15×12×7 cm ovarian mass contained a pedunculated fibroma component. Collision tumors represent two distinct tumors in the same organ without intermixture, and proper identification of each component is important for management.

pmid-33434070.summary_ja: ベラルーシの進行性胚細胞がん患者111例（95%が精巣がん）を対象とした後方視的コホート研究で、IGCCCGリスク分類別の転帰を検討した。5年PFSは70%、5年OSは77%であった。予後不良群の生存は（5年OS 38%）、IGCCCGの過去データと比べ有意に劣っていた。
pmid-33434070.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of Belarusian patients with advanced germ cell cancer (111 patients, 95% testicular) examined outcomes stratified by IGCCCG risk classification. Five-year PFS and OS rates were 70% and 77% respectively. Poor prognosis group showed significantly inferior survival (5-year OS 38%) compared to IGCCCG historical data.

pmid-33435376.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（OYST）患者10例の分子特性をFoundationOneCDxで検討。40%で分子異常が同定、33.3%でKRAS、KIT、ARID1Aの標的可能な変異を認めた。白金系化学療法以外の標的療法の可能性を示唆。
pmid-33435376.summary_en: This retrospective study examined molecular characteristics of ten ovarian yolk sac tumor patients using FoundationOne CDx analysis. Molecular alterations were identified in 40% of cases, with three patients harboring targetable mutations in KRAS, KIT, and ARID1A. Two relapsed patients had targetable mutations, suggesting potential for targeted therapeutic strategies beyond platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-33438088.summary_ja: 繰り返す尿閉で発症した16歳女性の大型仙骨尾骨部嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。腹腔鏡と後方アプローチを組み合わせた手術で成功裏に切除。大型仙骨尾骨部腫瘍の管理における安全で有効な外科的技法。
pmid-33438088.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old female with large sacrococcygeal cystic teratoma presenting with recurrent urinary retention. Imaging confirmed the mass, and combined laparoscopic and posterior approach surgery successfully resected the tumor without major complications. The combined surgical technique provides a safe and effective method for managing large sacrococcygeal tumors.

pmid-33440951.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫（成熟4例、未熟1例）に抗NMDAR脳炎を伴った5例を解析した。患者は神経精神症状と自律神経機能障害を呈した。血清抗NMDAR抗体は全例で陽性であった。免疫療法と外科的腫瘍切除の併用により、全例で良好な予後が得られた。
pmid-33440951.summary_en: This study analyzed five patients with ovarian teratoma (four mature, one immature) associated with anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Patients presented with neuropsychiatric symptoms and autonomic dysfunction. Serum anti-NMDAR antibodies were positive in all cases. Combined immunotherapy and surgical tumor resection resulted in favorable prognosis in all patients.

pmid-33446872.summary_ja: 胎児の先天性顔頸部腫瘤130例の出生前診断を検討した横断面研究。リンパ管奇形（119例）、奇形腫（2例）、甲状舌管嚢胞（2例）などを含む。出生前超音波検査の診断精度は93.85%、MRIは気道圧迫や解剖学的関係の評価に有用。
pmid-33446872.summary_en: This retrospective cross-sectional study examined prenatal diagnosis of congenital facio-cervical masses in 130 cases. Lesions included lymphatic malformations (119 cases), teratomas (2 cases), thyroglossal duct cysts (2), hemangiomas (4), and others. Prenatal ultrasound demonstrated 93.85% diagnostic accuracy, with MRI providing additional assessment of airway compression.

pmid-33449267.summary_ja: 4ヶ月齢男児に発生した前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の稀な症例を報告。進行性の呼吸困難と喘鳴で発症。画像検査で縦隔腫瘤が同定され、病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。外科的切除で良好な予後が得られた。
pmid-33449267.summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature cystic teratoma of the anterior mediastinum in a 4-month-old male infant presenting with progressive dyspnea and stridor. Imaging studies (chest radiography, ultrasound, CT) identified the mediastinal mass, and histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Surgical resection was performed with excellent postoperative outcome.

pmid-33454815.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍患者12名に対する精巣温存手術の20年間の成績を報告。症例の大多数は未思春期で成熟奇形腫（62%）であった。再発は1例のみで、精巣萎縮例なし。文献レビュー269例でも再発は1.1%。
pmid-33454815.summary_en: This 20-year single-center study evaluated testis-sparing surgery in 12 pediatric testicular tumor patients as alternative to radical orchidectomy. Most patients were prepubertal with mature teratoma (62%). Only one patient experienced early recurrence, with no cases of testicular atrophy. Systematic literature review of 269 patients showed recurrence in only 1.1%.

pmid-33455540.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者931名のSEERデータベース解析で、リンパ節比率（LNR）がリンパ節個数（LNC）より予後予測能に優れることを示した。LNRは多変量解析で有意に予後と関連（HR 3.009）し、LNCは関連なかった。LNRは臨床病理学的特性とAJCC病期とより良好に相関。
pmid-33455540.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 931 testicular germ cell tumor patients from SEER database examined lymph node ratio (LNR) versus positive lymph node count as prognostic factors. Univariate analysis showed LNR was significantly associated with prognosis (HR 3.009), while LNC was not (HR 1.743). LNR correlated better with clinical-pathological characteristics and AJCC stage.

pmid-33461068.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞から3次元オルガノイドを構築し、栄養芽層の増殖と分化のモデルとして検証した。WNT/EGFシグナルの活性化とTGF-βシグナルの阻害下では増殖能が低下し、栄養膜細胞特異的遺伝子の発現が抑制された。妊娠絨毛疾患の研究に有用なモデルシステム。
pmid-33461068.summary_en: This study established 3D JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell organoids as a model for trophoblast expansion and differentiation. Using stem cell culture conditions with WNT/EGF signaling activation and TGF-β inhibition, organoids showed reduced proliferation and abolished extravillous trophoblast gene expression. These organoids serve as a valuable model for studying directed differentiation in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-33469349.summary_ja: 195例の生殖細胞腫瘍のTdT免疫組織化学的発現の多施設研究。セミノーマ・ジスジェルミノーマ・胚細胞癌では94-100%陽性、卵黄嚢腫瘍・奇形腫は陰性。新規診断マーカーとしての価値を確認。
pmid-33469349.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of TdT expression in 195 GCTs from multiple centers. Nearly all seminomas, GCNISs, dysgerminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and extragonadal germinomas were TdT-positive (94-100%), while yolk sac tumors and teratomas were negative (0%). TdT can serve as a new marker for germinal GCTs, preventing diagnostic errors particularly in core needle biopsies.

pmid-33478834.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性生殖細胞腫瘍の胸部摘出術89例解析。肺間の病理学的一致性は高いが肺と縦隔間では低い。化学療法耐性例でも優良予後可能性あり、積極的外科管理推奨。
pmid-33478834.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 89 men undergoing thoracic resection for metastatic NSGCT (median age 29 years). Pathologic concordance between lungs was high (85-91%) but lower between lung and mediastinum (50-72.7%). Despite chemotherapy refractory disease in some cases, aggressive surgical approach recommended given potential for excellent long-term survival.

pmid-33482158.summary_ja: 成人患者の右心室流出路閉塞の極めて稀な症例。呼吸困難とめまいで呈示。手術摘出により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認。心臓部位の奇形腫は極めて稀。
pmid-33482158.summary_en: Case of exceedingly rare right ventricular outflow tract obstructing mass in adult patient presenting with dyspnea and dizziness. Imaging revealed large mass obstructing right ventricular outflow. Surgical resection via dual right ventriculotomy and right atriotomy confirmed histopathologically as mature cystic teratoma, representing an extremely unusual cardiac location.

pmid-33482165.summary_ja: 上大静脈の切除と再建を要した、21歳男性の悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。右腕頭静脈から右心房へ、静脈還流カニュレーションを用いた胸郭外の一時的静脈バイパスを行う新たな手技を記述している。静脈浸潤を伴う浸潤性縦隔GCTの管理において、安全かつ有効な方法を示している。
pmid-33482165.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old male with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor requiring superior vena cava resection and reconstruction. Describes novel use of extrathoracic temporary venous bypass from right brachiocephalic vein to right atrium using venous return cannula, providing safe and effective technique for managing invasive mediastinal GCTs with venous involvement.

pmid-33482463.summary_ja: TGCT症例308例と対照323例を対象とした集団ベースの症例対照研究で、血清PCB濃度を検討したものである。総PCBは全体のTGCTリスクと関連を示さなかった。一方、Wolffのグループ1(潜在的にエストロゲン様作用を有する)PCBは、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの両亜型と強い正の関連を示し、内分泌攪乱の機序が示唆された。
pmid-33482463.summary_en: Population-based case-control study of 308 testicular GCT cases and 323 controls examining serum PCB levels. Total PCBs showed no association with overall TGCT risk, but Wolff's Group 1 (potentially estrogenic) PCBs showed strong positive association with both seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes, suggesting endocrine disruption mechanism.

pmid-33486494.summary_ja: 42名の専門家が作成した、成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理に関するドイツ臨床診療ガイドラインの第2部である。進行病期、残存腫瘤の管理、再発・難治性疾患、性腺外腫瘍、性索・間質性腫瘍、フォローアップ、毒性管理、生活の質、緩和ケア、支持療法について、エビデンスに基づく推奨を示している。
pmid-33486494.summary_en: Second part of German clinical practice guideline on testicular germ cell tumor management in adults, developed by 42 interdisciplinary experts. Covers advanced disease stages, residual mass management, relapsed and refractory disease, extragonadal tumors, sex cord/stromal tumors, follow-up, toxicity management, quality-of-life, palliative care, and supportive therapy with evidence-based recommendations.

pmid-33489412.summary_ja: growing teratoma syndromeの症例報告。画像による経過観察中に進行性の新たな二次病変が出現し、腫瘍マーカーは正常化していたが、組織学的に奇形腫と確認された。26歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例で、慎重な臨床経過観察の解釈が必要とされる。
pmid-33489412.summary_en: Case report of growing teratoma syndrome, a rare phenomenon in which progressive new secondary lesions appear during imaging surveillance despite chemotherapy response. Occurred in 26-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor; lesions were histologically confirmed as teratomas despite normalized tumor markers, requiring careful clinical follow-up interpretation.

pmid-33490353.summary_ja: 46XY性分化疾患を伴う転移性ジスジェルミノーマの稀な症例。24歳で両側卵巣腫瘍で呈示。DSD患者とくにY染色体物質保有者はGCT発生リスク高。化学療法後に腫瘍崩壊症候群発症。
pmid-33490353.summary_en: Case of bilateral dysgerminoma in a 24-year-old 46XY DSD patient presenting with abdominal mass. Individuals with DSD, particularly those with Y chromosomal material, have significantly increased germ cell tumor risk. Treated with Carboplatin and Etoposide chemotherapy, subsequently developing tumor lysis syndrome requiring exploratory laparotomy.

pmid-33491277.summary_ja: 進行転移性胚細胞腫瘍の前治療歴の多い12例を対象とした、ペムブロリズマブの第II相試験。全体として忍容性は良好であったが、27週時点の非増悪率は9%、無増悪生存期間中央値は2.4か月で、抗腫瘍活性は限定的であった。低い腫瘍遺伝子変異量や低いPD-1発現などの腫瘍生物学的因子が結果の一因と考えられている。
pmid-33491277.summary_en: Phase II trial of pembrolizumab in 12 heavily pretreated patients with advanced metastatic germ cell tumors. Overall well tolerated but showed limited antitumor activity with non-progression rate of 9% at 27 weeks and median progression-free survival of 2.4 months. Results attributed to tumor biology factors including low tumor mutational burden and low PD-1 expression.

pmid-33493632.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカーに関する包括的な総説で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)を扱う。これらのマーカーはセミノーマの15～20%、非セミノーマの60～80%で発現し、診断、病期分類、予後、治療反応のモニタリング、フォローアップにおいて重要な役割を果たす。近年の研究では、追加のバイオマーカーとしてmiRNAが提案されている。
pmid-33493632.summary_en: Comprehensive review of serum tumor markers in germ cell tumors, including human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH). Expressed in 15-20% of seminomas and 60-80% of non-seminomas, these markers serve critical roles in diagnosis, staging, prognosis, monitoring treatment response, and follow-up. Recent studies propose miRNAs as additional biomarkers.

pmid-33498105.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫(未熟奇形腫を含む)に関連した抗NMDAR脳炎の3症例。患者は精神症状、けいれん、記憶障害などの神経症状と腹痛を呈した。全例が奇形腫の外科的切除の後、免疫療法を受け、症状は徐々に改善した。本疾患が自己免疫性の傍腫瘍性の性質を持つことを示している。
pmid-33498105.summary_en: Three cases of anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratomas, including immature teratoma. Patients presented with neurological symptoms (psychosis, seizures, memory deficits) and abdominal pain. All underwent surgical teratoma resection followed by immunotherapy with progressive symptom improvement, illustrating the paraneoplastic nature of this autoimmune disorder.

pmid-33499917.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化2例報告。発症率1-3%。腹痛・体重減少で呈示。病期が予後を決定する最重要因子で、早期診断・治療が予後改善に必須。
pmid-33499917.summary_en: Two cases of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) with malignant transformation, a complication occurring in 1-3% of MCTs. Both patients presented with chronic abdominal pain and weight loss. Disease stage proved the most important prognostic factor, with stage Ia showing good prognosis and stage IIIc poor prognosis, emphasizing early diagnosis importance.

pmid-33502089.summary_ja: 1983年から2019年の間に治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者22例の後方視的解析。セミノーマ5例、非セミノーマ性GCT17例。15例(68.2%)が化学療法後に胸部外科手術を受けた。10年全生存率はセミノーマで100%、NSGCTで64.7%であった。化学療法中に4例でgrowing teratoma syndromeが発症した。
pmid-33502089.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 22 primary mediastinal germ cell tumor patients treated 1983-2019. 5 had seminoma, 17 had nonseminomatous GCT. 15 (68.2%) underwent thoracic surgery after chemotherapy. 10-year overall survival was 100% for seminoma and 64.7% for NSGCT. Growing teratoma syndrome developed in 4 cases.

pmid-33502887.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ患者139例を対象に、積極的監視(低リスク77例)と補助化学療法(高リスク62例)を比較した研究。再発率はそれぞれ13.0%と8.1%であった。両群とも全生存率は100%であった。リスクに応じた治療選択の妥当性が示唆されている。
pmid-33502887.summary_en: Study of 139 clinical stage I testicular seminoma patients comparing active surveillance (low-risk, 77 patients) versus adjuvant chemotherapy (high-risk, 62 patients). Relapse occurred in 13% and 8.1%, respectively. Overall survival was 100% for both groups.

pmid-33509882.summary_ja: 絨毛膜絨毛腫瘍(妊娠関連絨毛疾患)の症例報告である。30歳女性が分娩後3カ月の異常出血で発症、子宮肥大と血中hCG上昇を認めた。子宮鏡下生検で診断、化学療法で完全寛解を達成した。
pmid-33509882.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor, a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease accounting for 1-2% of trophoblastic tumors. A 30-year-old woman presented with abnormal postpartum bleeding. Hysteroscopic biopsy confirmed diagnosis; pulmonary micronodules were found. Hysterectomy and chemotherapy resulted in complete remission.

pmid-33510121.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎と成熟卵巣奇形腫を併発した16歳女性の症例報告。当初ウイルス性脳炎と誤診された後、画像検査で3.6×2.64×3.18cmの卵巣腫瘤が認められた。嚢胞摘出術が施行され、血清および脳脊髄液で抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性であった。
pmid-33510121.summary_en: Case report of a 16-year-old female with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and mature ovarian teratoma. After initial misdiagnosis as viral encephalitis, imaging revealed a 3.6×2.64×3.18 cm ovarian mass. Cystectomy was performed and serum/CSF tested positive for anti-NMDA receptor antibodies.

pmid-33512871.summary_ja: 術前化学療法を受けた20例を含む、小児仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍26例の後方視的解析。化学療法後に悪性成分がなかった患者は再発しなかった(0/9)が、生存腫瘍が残存した患者では7/11例で再発した。5年再発のない生存率は55.2%、全生存率は100%であった。
pmid-33512871.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 26 children with sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumors. 20 received neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Pathologic complete response (no malignant cells) predicted no recurrence (0/9), while viable residual tumor led to recurrence in 7/11 cases. 5-year relapse-free and overall survival were 55.2% and 100%.

pmid-33513287.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者のPARP阻害薬応答性がBRCA1、RAD51C等の相同組換え遺伝子のメチル化で予測可能であることを示した。非セミノーマは高いメチル化レベルを示し、Olaparib感受性と関連していた。
pmid-33513287.summary_en: Study identifying BRCA1, RAD51C, PALB2, RAD54B, and SYCP3 promoter methylation as predictors of PARP inhibitor responsiveness in testicular germ cell tumors. Nonseminomas showed higher methylation levels, and differential methylation of BRCA1 and RAD51C correlated with Olaparib sensitivity.

pmid-33514417.summary_ja: 盲腸由来の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術例である。35歳女性で術前は卵巣嚢腫と診断されたが、卵巣は正常で盲腸壁から発生していた。10×7×5cmの腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除した。
pmid-33514417.summary_en: First laparoscopically managed case of a cecal dermoid (mature cystic teratoma) in a 35-year-old woman misdiagnosed preoperatively as an ovarian cyst. The 10×7×5 cm mass originated from the cecum at the ileocecal junction and was successfully resected.

pmid-33515399.summary_ja: 化学療法にもかかわらずgrowing teratoma syndromeを発症した、25歳男性の巨大縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。左腕頭静脈と上大静脈に浸潤した20cmの成熟奇形腫に対し、血管再建を伴う積極的な外科的切除が必要であった。
pmid-33515399.summary_en: Case report of a 25-year-old with giant mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor developing growing teratoma syndrome despite chemotherapy. A 20-cm mature teratoma invading the left brachiocephalic vein and SVC required aggressive surgical resection with vascular reconstruction.

pmid-33518697.summary_ja: 68歳女性が下血を主訴とした、稀な原発性成熟充実性直腸奇形腫の症例報告。4cmの有茎性ポリープをポリペクトミーにより切除した。組織学的に3胚葉すべての成熟成分が認められ、未熟成分や悪性の特徴は認められなかった。
pmid-33518697.summary_en: Case report of a rare primary mature solid teratoma of the rectum in a 68-year-old woman presenting with hematochezia. A 4-cm pedunculated polyp was resected by polypectomy. Histology showed mature components from all three germ layers without immature or malignant features.

pmid-33530223.summary_ja: 台湾の単一施設における、悪性仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児15名の後方視的解析。新生児期に発症した例(未熟奇形腫5例、成熟奇形腫2例)は予後が良好で、年長児には術前化学療法が行われた。5年全生存率は90%、無イベント生存率は80%であった。
pmid-33530223.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 15 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors in Taiwan. Neonatal presentation (immature teratoma 5 cases, mature 2 cases) had better outcomes; older children received neoadjuvant chemotherapy. 5-year overall and event-free survival rates were 90% and 80%, respectively.

pmid-33530802.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎に続発した絨毛癌患者(55歳)の頭蓋内転移による脳出血の緊急手術例である。脳ヘルニアを生じ緊急開頭手術を施行、その後化学療法と リハビリテーション を施行した。
pmid-33530802.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma secondary to hydatidiform mole with intracranial metastasis and cerebral hemorrhage in a 55-year-old woman. Emergency craniotomy was performed for brain herniation, followed by chemotherapy and rehabilitation.

pmid-33530806.summary_ja: 頸部悪性奇形腫と診断された24歳男性の症例報告。実際には未熟精巣奇形腫でリンパ節転移と腹部転移を伴っていた。血腫と誤認された経緯を示し、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の提示における診断上の難しさを強調している。
pmid-33530806.summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old man with cervical malignant teratoma that was actually immature testicular teratoma with lymph node metastases and abdominal metastases. Highlights the diagnostic challenge of extragonadal germ cell tumor presentations.

pmid-33530815.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化12症例の臨床病理学的検討である。患者の中央年齢は56.5歳、腫瘍平均サイズは18.5cm であった。年齢と腫瘍サイズが悪性転化の重要な予後因子として同定された。
pmid-33530815.summary_en: Retrospective study of 12 cases of malignant transformation of mature cystic ovarian teratoma, predominantly to squamous cell carcinoma. Median patient age was 56.5 years, median tumor size 18.5 cm. Age and tumor size were identified as important prognostic factors.

pmid-33532243.summary_ja: 精巣原発胚胎癌の尿道転移の初症例報告である。34歳男性患者で、精巣と尿道の両者に胚胎癌が認められ、BEP化学療法にもかかわらず脳転移で死亡した。
pmid-33532243.summary_en: First case report of urethral metastasis from primary embryonal carcinoma of the testis in a 34-year-old man with prior urethral stricture. Both the testicular and urethral masses showed embryonal carcinoma histology. Despite BEP chemotherapy, the patient died of brain metastasis.

pmid-33532328.summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用いた、精巣絨毛癌788例とセミノーマ19,571例の集団ベース研究。絨毛癌患者は若年で、遠隔転移(41%)を有する割合が高く、5年全生存率(85.5%対97.3%)はセミノーマ患者より不良であった。
pmid-33532328.summary_en: Population-based study of 788 testicular choriocarcinoma cases compared with 19,571 seminoma cases using the SEER database. Choriocarcinoma patients were younger, more likely to have metastatic disease (41% distant), and had worse 5-year overall survival (85.5% vs 97.3%) than seminoma patients.

pmid-33534171.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの新規バイオマーカーの包括的なレビューである。miRNA-371-3pを含むマイクロRNAや胚性幹細胞遺伝子をGCT診断・治療の標的として提案している。リスク評価、診断、予後判定、再発監視への臨床応用を論述している。
pmid-33534171.summary_en: Comprehensive review of novel biomarkers for testicular germ cell tumors, including microRNA-371-3p, for risk assessment, diagnosis, prognosis, and monitoring recurrence. Discusses the similarities between cancer cells and embryonic stem cells as the basis for GCT-specific diagnostic and therapeutic targets.

pmid-33537140.summary_ja: 肺動脈圧迫による右心室流出路閉塞をきたした前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。左側開胸による腫瘍摘出後に症状が著明に改善し、縦隔奇形腫の合併症に対する外科治療の重要性を示す。
pmid-33537140.summary_en: Case report of anterior mediastinal teratoma in 36-year-old female presenting with dyspnea. CT imaging revealed mass compressing main pulmonary artery causing right ventricular outflow tract obstruction; surgical resection through left thoracotomy resulted in dramatic symptom improvement.

pmid-33541424.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療から20年後に、稀な転移を伴う異時性精巣セミノーマを発症した症例。EGCT治療後の長期フォローアップと精巣の監視の重要性が示されている。
