pmid-34326734.summary_en: Case report of metastatic testicular germ cell tumor in poor-risk patient refractory to standard chemotherapy. Treated with high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) followed by autologous stem-cell transplantation, achieving long-term disease-free survival.

pmid-34326736.summary_ja: 27歳女性の再発した腹腔内卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)の症例報告。当初6サイクルの化学療法を行ったが改善がなかった。その後、3D-CRTによる根治的放射線療法を施行し、臨床的な改善が認められた。
pmid-34326736.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old female with recurrent intra-abdominal yolk sac tumor (YST). Initially treated with six chemotherapy cycles without improvement. Subsequently underwent 3D-conformal radiotherapy with clinical improvement.

pmid-34327722.summary_ja: 出生前診断された仙尾部奇形腫84胎児の後方視的研究。全体死亡率32.1%、流産除外で13.1%。胎児水腫と心肥大が予後不良因子として同定。
pmid-34327722.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 84 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT). Overall mortality 32.1%, excluding terminations 13.1%. Fetal hydrops and cardiomegaly identified as risk factors for poor outcome. Describes fetal interventions.

pmid-34331503.summary_ja: 片側卵巣成熟奇形腫治療後の対側同時性腫瘍に関するシステマティックレビュー。1101人の女児を含む23論文を分析。全体有病率2.1%、厳密な監視では7%。超音波監視を推奨。
pmid-34331503.summary_en: Systematic review of metachronous contralateral mature ovarian teratomas in girls with unilateral disease. Analyzed 23 studies reporting 1101 girls. Overall prevalence 2.1%, higher (7%) with robust surveillance. Recommends surveillance ultrasonography and prospective data collection.

pmid-34333124.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に続発した再発性growing teratoma syndromeの小児患者の症例報告。化学療法、減量手術、凍結療法による治療を記述している。転移性の未熟腫瘍が化学療法後に成熟腫瘍へ変化する病態についても論じている。
pmid-34333124.summary_en: Case report of pediatric patient with recurrent growing teratoma syndrome following immature ovarian teratoma. Describes treatment with chemotherapy, debulking procedures, and cryoablation. Discusses pathogenesis where metastatic immature tumor converts to mature tumor after chemotherapy.

pmid-34333954.summary_ja: 40歳女性の肝臓に発生した、絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍からなる原発性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。血清hCGの上昇、腫瘍マーカー所見、術前化学療法後の肝切除、両成分の免疫組織化学的特徴を記載している。
pmid-34333954.summary_en: Case report of primary hepatic mixed germ cell tumor composed of choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor in 40-year-old woman. Elevated serum hCG, tumor markers, neoadjuvant chemotherapy, hepatic resection, and characteristic immunohistochemical features of both components described.

pmid-34336320.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞奇形腫の悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）を呈した53歳閉経後女性の症例。画像所見、組織学的診断、手術と化学療法による多学科治療、および良好な臨床転帰について報告している。
pmid-34336320.summary_en: Case report of 53-year-old postmenopausal woman with malignant transformation of mature ovarian cystic teratoma to squamous cell carcinoma. Discusses clinical presentation, imaging findings, histological diagnosis, and multidisciplinary treatment including surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-34337537.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発（2年以上）101症例の臨床分析。中央値96ヶ月。化学療法後の再発では思春期後奇形腫が優位。外科治療で良好な成績。
pmid-34337537.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 101 patients with late relapse (after 2+ years disease-free interval) of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Median time to relapse 96 months; postpubertal teratoma predominated in patients with prior chemotherapy; surgical management achieved good outcomes.

pmid-34338390.summary_ja: KIT遺伝子の新規胚系列変異（K558N）がGIST、肥満細胞症、セミノーマの発症に関連。セミノーマ発症機序の理解に貢献。
pmid-34338390.summary_en: Reports novel germline KIT exon 11 mutation (K558N) associated with gastrointestinal stromal tumors, mastocytosis, and seminoma development. Describes structural mechanisms of KIT activation and implications for understanding seminoma pathogenesis within familial GIST kindreds.

pmid-34340578.summary_ja: 思春期女性（平均16.17歳）の大きな卵巣腫瘤（≥10 cm）52症例の臨床分析。奇形腫が最多。腹腔鏡手術と開腹術の比較、生殖機能温存について報告。
pmid-34340578.summary_en: Retrospective clinical analysis of 52 adolescent patients (mean age 16.17 years) with large ovarian masses (≥10 cm). Teratomas constituted the greatest group; study compares laparoscopic versus laparotomy approaches and reports outcomes with fertility preservation.

pmid-34340579.summary_ja: 超高リスク絨毛癌（stage IV）で脾臓破裂を伴った症例。化学療法、免疫療法、標的治療を含む包括的治療で良好な転帰を得た。
pmid-34340579.summary_en: Case report of ultra-high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma (stage IV) presenting with hemorrhage secondary to atraumatic splenic rupture as initial sign. Successfully managed with comprehensive multimodal treatment including surgery, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy.

pmid-34340710.summary_ja: 先天性上顎奇形腫（エピグナトゥス）の症例。硬口蓋の良性先天性奇形腫。呼吸障害と口蓋裂を伴う。生後5日目に摘出術、その後口蓋形成術施行。
pmid-34340710.summary_en: Case report of benign congenital teratoma (epignathus) of hard palate in newborn presenting with respiratory compromise and cleft palate. Successful surgical resection on day 5 after birth followed by palatal reconstruction and good outcome.

pmid-34341387.summary_ja: 180例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした前向き研究で、デジタルドロップレットPCRによるマイクロRNA-371の検出を、従来のバイオマーカーであるAFPおよびβ-hCGと比較した。miR-371は全体で89％の感度を示し、特にセミノーマ（感度87％）で優れた性能を示した。
pmid-34341387.summary_en: Prospective study of 180 testicular germ cell cancer patients comparing microRNA-371 detection via digital droplet PCR with classical biomarkers AFP and beta-hCG. MiR-371 shows 89% sensitivity overall and superior performance especially in seminomas (87% sensitivity).

pmid-34342367.summary_ja: カンボジアにおける水胞状奇胎と妊娠滋養膜疾患の医療体制に関する調査。水胞状奇胎の発生率は1000分娩あたり0.95例、絨毛膜上皮腫瘍は100,000分娩あたり6.58例。
pmid-34342367.summary_en: Survey-based study assessing health services for hydatidiform mole and gestational trophoblastic disease in Cambodia. Reports incidence of hydatidiform mole (0.95 per 1000 deliveries) and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (6.58 per 100,000 deliveries) in public sector facilities.

pmid-34343969.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断におけるマイクロRNAの有用性のシステマティックレビュー。miR-371a-3pは感度84%、特異度95%で、古典的マーカーより優れた診断性能を示す。
pmid-34343969.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 trials evaluating microRNA diagnostic performance in testicular germ cell tumors. MiR-371a-3p shows pooled sensitivity 84% and specificity 95% for detecting TGCTs; superior performance compared to classical biomarkers except in teratomas.

pmid-34345596.summary_ja: 妊娠36週の胎児死亡をもたらした胎盤内絨毛癌の症例。胎盤の病理検査で確認。経過観察とhCG測定で管理され良好に経過。
pmid-34345596.summary_en: Case report of intraplacental choriocarcinoma diagnosed at 36 weeks after fetal demise from fetomaternal hemorrhage. Histopathological placental examination confirmed diagnosis; managed with monitoring and serial beta-hCG testing until full recovery achieved.

pmid-34347114.summary_ja: 純型セミノーマと混合型腫瘍内セミノーマ成分の遺伝子発現解析。亜鉛代謝関連遺伝子の差異発現を検出し、腫瘍進行機構を示唆する。
pmid-34347114.summary_en: Gene expression microarray analysis comparing pure-type seminomas to seminoma components in mixed testicular germ cell tumors. Identifies differentially expressed genes related to zinc metabolism, suggesting molecular mechanisms underlying tumor reprogramming and progression.

pmid-34348686.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の生殖機能温存手術と化学療法の治療成績。10年無病生存率94.4%。妊娠希望者の73%が出産に至った。
pmid-34348686.summary_en: Retrospective study of 79 young women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with fertility-sparing surgery and chemotherapy. Reports 94.4% 10-year overall survival; 73% of 26 women attempting pregnancy achieved delivery without requiring infertility treatments.

pmid-34352873.summary_ja: 妊娠34週に診断された転移性絨毛癌の症例。出血と咳血で発症。帝王切開と化学療法で治療。絨毛癌は化学療法感受性が高く予後が良好。
pmid-34352873.summary_en: Case report of metastatic choriocarcinoma diagnosed at 34 weeks gestation presenting with metrorrhagia and hemoptysis. Managed with cesarean delivery and chemotherapy; notes high chemotherapy sensitivity and good survival rates in gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-34354085.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ型）の注釈付きT2強調MRI画像44枚のデータセット。統計モデルの検証と腫瘍画像特性の研究に利用可能。
pmid-34354085.summary_en: Publishes dataset of 44 annotated T2-weighted MRI images from 42 patients with testicular germ cell tumors (seminomatous and non-seminomatous types). Aims to provide imaging data for validating statistical models and investigating TGCT imaging features.

pmid-34356961.summary_ja: 大きな卵巣腫瘤（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む）に対する新しい単一切開腹腔鏡手術技術を報告。7症例全例で合併症なく、生殖能温存が実現された。
pmid-34356961.summary_en: Introduces single-incision laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy technique for large ovarian masses including mature cystic teratomas. Reports successful outcomes in 7 reproductive-aged women with no perioperative complications and good fertility preservation.

pmid-34357489.summary_ja: 成人の仙骨部奇形腫の稀な症例報告。27歳女性が腹痛と性器出血で受診。MRIで3cm左後直腸腔腫瘤を確認。内視鏡的経仙骨アプローチで摘出し、成熟奇形腫と確認された。
pmid-34357489.summary_en: Rare case report of adult sacrococcygeal teratoma (presacral cystic mass) in 27-year-old woman presenting with abdominal pain and genital bleeding. Successfully resected using novel endoscopic transsacral approach; confirmed as mature teratoma with uneventful postoperative recovery.

pmid-34359581.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と奇形腫、および様々な体細胞癌におけるDND1の役割に関する包括的総説。翻訳制御におけるRNA結合タンパク質の作用機序を述べ、Dnd1(Ter)変異がマウスに自然発生的なTGCTと奇形腫を引き起こす仕組みを説明している。また、腫瘍抑制性および腫瘍促進性の新たな役割についても論じている。
pmid-34359581.summary_en: Comprehensive review of DND1's role in testicular germ cell tumors and teratomas, and various somatic cancers. Describes mechanisms of RNA-binding protein activity in translational regulation; discusses how DND1(Ter) mutation leads to spontaneous TGCT/teratomas in mice and emerging tumor-suppressive/promoting roles.

pmid-34360857.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマなど精巣疾患におけるDAM1およびPREP蛋白の発現と局在の検討。これらの蛋白が細胞骨格ダイナミクスの変化と関連し、新規マーカーとしての可能性を提唱している。
pmid-34360857.summary_en: Investigation of cytoskeleton-related proteins DAAM1 and PREP in testicular seminoma, Leydig cell tumor, and Sertoli cell-only syndrome. Demonstrates altered protein levels and localization patterns; proposes these as potential markers for cytoarchitecture changes during pathological differentiation.

pmid-34362879.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるlncRNA発現プロファイルを包括的に解析した研究。LINC00467が転移促進因子として同定され、予後不良や高い病理学的悪性度と相関することが示された。また、免疫細胞浸潤およびPD-1免疫療法への反応とは負の相関を示した。
pmid-34362879.summary_en: Comprehensive analysis of lncRNA expression profiles in testicular germ cell tumors. Identifies LINC00467 as key metastasis promoter correlated with poor prognosis and high pathological grade; negatively correlates with immune infiltration and PD-1 immunotherapy response.

pmid-34363325.summary_ja: 12,381例の腫瘍を対象とした大規模な組織マイクロアレイ研究で、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)発現を検討した。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍ではセミノーマ96%、胎児性癌85%、卵黄嚢腫瘍56%と高い陽性率を示した。PLAP発現の臨床的意義は腫瘍型により異なっていた。
pmid-34363325.summary_en: Large tissue microarray study examining placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) expression across 12,381 tumors. Identified high PLAP positivity in testicular GCTs (seminoma 96%, embryonal carcinoma 85%, yolk sac tumor 56%); clinical significance varies by tumor type.

pmid-34367724.summary_ja: 治癒可能ながんモデルとしての精巣胚細胞腫瘍を検討したミニレビュー。腫瘍内不均一性と幹細胞由来の起源に着目し、生物学的知見、臨床的教訓、治療戦略を論じている。標的療法よりも多角的治療が有効であることを強調している。
pmid-34367724.summary_en: Mini-review examining testicular germ cell tumors as a curable cancer model with intrinsic intratumoral heterogeneity reflecting stem-cell origin. Discusses biological insights, clinical lessons, and therapeutic strategies applicable to other solid tumors; emphasizes multimodal over targeted therapy.

pmid-34367821.summary_ja: 卵巣衝突腫瘍の症例で、良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と巨大粘液性嚢胞腺腫が同時存在。腹部痛と腹部膨満を主訴とし、病理学的に両腫瘍の共存が確認された。
pmid-34367821.summary_en: Rare case report of ovarian collision tumor in 28-year-old woman presenting with worsening abdominal pain. Imaging and surgical findings revealed coexisting benign mature cystic teratoma and massive mucinous cystadenoma with significant ascites.

pmid-34368414.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した転移性扁平上皮がんがペムブロリズマブで奏効した症例。奇形腫由来悪性腫瘍の治療戦略と免疫関連有害事象の監視の重要性を示している。
pmid-34368414.summary_en: Case report of metastatic squamous cell carcinoma arising from presumed ovarian mature cystic teratoma successfully treated with pembrolizumab immunotherapy. Highlights importance of immune-related adverse event monitoring in teratoma-derived malignancies.

pmid-34384861.summary_ja: 「burned out」精巣がんに関するスコーピングレビューで、遠隔転移を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍が自然に完全退縮する現象を扱っている。68例の仮想コホートから診断上の不一致が示され、明確な定義の標準化と、診断的評価および治療プロトコルの最適化の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-34384861.summary_en: Scoping review of burned-out testicular cancer (spontaneous complete regression of testicular GCT with distant metastases). Virtual cohort of 68 patients highlights diagnostic inconsistencies; emphasizes need for standardized definition and optimized diagnostic workup and treatment protocols.

pmid-34386804.summary_ja: 新生児から口腔外に突出した先天性咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）の症例。上顎扁桃から発生した巨大腫瘍で、成熟奇形腫と診断され、生後3日目の手術で完全摘出、6ヶ月の経過観察で再発なし。
pmid-34386804.summary_en: Rare case report of giant epignathus (congenital oropharyngeal teratoma) originating from tonsillar region in neonate. Confirmed as mature teratoma on histopathology; successfully excised on postnatal day 3 with no airway obstruction and complete recovery without recurrence.

pmid-34387530.summary_ja: 卵巣ストルマ・オバリ（50%以上が甲状腺組織の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）による治療抵抗性甲状腺機能亢進症の症例報告。双側卵巣腫瘍に対して両側卵巣摘出を施行し、成熟奇形腫を確認した。
pmid-34387530.summary_en: Case report and literature review of struma ovarii—mature cystic teratoma with thyroid tissue component—as rare cause of hyperthyroidism. 30-year-old patient with treatment-resistant hyperthyroidism was found to have bilateral ovarian teratomas; bilateral oophorectomy confirmed mature teratoma diagnosis.

pmid-34389428.summary_ja: 精巣純セミノーマ患者9,849名中821名のAFP上昇症例を分析。AFP上昇は潜在的非セミノーマ成分の存在を示唆し、治療パターンがセミノーマとして管理されている矛盾を指摘している。
pmid-34389428.summary_en: National Cancer Database analysis of 821 seminoma patients with elevated serum AFP despite pure seminomatous histology. Demonstrates that elevated AFP in seminoma implies occult nonseminomatous elements; patients received more adjuvant radiation but fewer lymph node dissections than expected.

pmid-34392955.summary_ja: 韓国の登録データに基づく疫学研究で、2,125例の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(1999～2017年)を解析した。ディスジャーミノーマでは5年生存率が98%と良好であった。診断後に続発悪性腫瘍を発症するリスクが有意に上昇しており、特に甲状腺がんが多かった。
pmid-34392955.summary_en: Korean registry-based epidemiological study of 2,125 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (1999-2017). Demonstrates excellent prognosis with 98% 5-year survival for dysgerminoma; identifies significantly increased risk of subsequent malignancies, particularly thyroid cancer.

pmid-34396640.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫とNMDAR自己免疫性脳炎の関連性を婦人科学的視点から総合的にレビュー。腫瘍組織でのNMDAR異所発現の機序、妊娠中の発症リスク、および卵巣腫瘍摘出による予後改善の重要性を述べている。
pmid-34396640.summary_en: Review examining the relationship between ovarian teratomas and anti-NMDAR encephalitis from a gynecological perspective. Discusses pathogenic mechanisms through ectopic NMDAR expression, clinical features, treatment strategies, and pregnancy outcomes in affected women.

pmid-34402242.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における転移性成熟奇形腫およびgrowing teratoma syndromeに関する総説である。奇形腫が胎児性癌成分に比べて化学療法に選択的に抵抗性を示す理由や、多モダリティ画像所見について検討している。残存する転移性成熟奇形腫の外科的切除やサーベイランス戦略など、臨床管理にも言及している。
pmid-34402242.summary_en: Review article on metastatic mature teratoma and growing teratoma syndrome in testicular non-seminomatous GCT patients. Discusses selective chemotherapy resistance of teratomas versus embryonal components, multimodality imaging features, and clinical management including surgical resection of residual mature teratomas and surveillance strategies.

pmid-34408122.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う24歳未産婦の症例報告。稀で悪性のGCT変異型。一側卵管卵巣摘除術と化学療法を受けた。妊孕性が保持され、体外受精により妊娠し、健康な満期児を出産した。
pmid-34408122.summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old nulliparous woman with ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST), a rare malignant GCT variant. Underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin chemotherapy with successful preservation of fertility. Subsequently conceived via in-vitro fertilization and delivered healthy term infant.

pmid-34408437.summary_ja: 非定型的に呈現する絨毛癌の症例報告：36歳女性は肺膿瘍として誤診、その後肺癌として誤診された。最終診断は複数臓器転移を伴う絨毛癌。非定型画像所見にもかかわらず臨床的疑念の重要性を強調している。
pmid-34408437.summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma with atypical presentation: 36-year-old female initially misdiagnosed as lung abscess, then lung cancer, with final diagnosis of choriocarcinoma with multiple metastases (lung, breast, brain, liver, kidney, bone). Emphasizes importance of high clinical suspicion for choriocarcinoma despite atypical imaging findings and clinical presentation.

pmid-34408618.summary_ja: 性的に活動していない16歳女性における非妊娠関連卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告。妊娠歴なしにもかかわらず、患者は陽性妊娠検査と共に呈現した。組織学的に第IV期の非妊娠関連絨毛癌が確認された。非常に稀なGCT変異型である。
pmid-34408618.summary_en: Case report of non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma in a 16-year-old sexually inactive girl. Despite negative reproductive history, patient presented with right iliac fossa pain and positive pregnancy test. Histopathology revealed stage IV non-gestational choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare GCT variant with significant diagnostic challenges.

pmid-34418038.summary_ja: 絨毛癌症候群（転移部位からの出血と上昇したベータhCG）を呈する純粋精巣絨毛癌の15歳男性症例報告。精巣摘除術により純粋絨毛癌が確認された。化学療法開始中に肺胞出血の合併症により死亡した。
pmid-34418038.summary_en: Case report of 15-year-old male with pure testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with choriocarcinoma syndrome—hemorrhage from metastatic sites with elevated beta-hCG levels. Orchiectomy confirmed pure choriocarcinoma histology. Patient died from alveolar hemorrhage complication during chemotherapy initiation.

pmid-34419077.summary_ja: 濾胞リンパ球過形成を伴う原発性縦隔精細胞腫の症例報告および文献レビュー。最初は胸腺腫が疑われた48歳男性は縦隔精細胞腫と診断された。縦隔GCTにおける精巣原発腫瘍除外の重要性を強調している。
pmid-34419077.summary_en: Case report and literature review of primary mediastinal seminoma with unusual florid follicular lymphoid hyperplasia. 48-year-old male initially suspected to have thymoma was found to have mediastinal seminoma. Emphasizes importance of tumor markers and gonadal ultrasound to exclude primary testicular involvement in mediastinal GCT.

pmid-34419852.summary_ja: 30歳男性の精巣がん症例報告で、性腺静脈および腎静脈に広範な腫瘍栓を認めた。腫瘍栓は悪性細胞の血管内浸潤によるもので、過凝固状態とは異なり、予後や治療選択肢に重要な意味を持つ。病期分類や精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理にも影響する点が述べられている。
pmid-34419852.summary_en: Case report of 30-year-old male with testicular germ cell cancer presenting with extensive gonadal and renal vein tumor thrombus. Tumor thrombus from intravascular invasion of malignant cells differs from hypercoagulability and carries significant implications for prognosis, staging, and therapeutic options in GCT management.

pmid-34423782.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞におけるATP6AP2のシンシティオ化と浸潤性への関与を検証した研究。FURIN によるsATP6AP2の切断メカニズムを確認し、sATP6AP2を絨毛癌の浸潤ポテンシャルの生物マーカーとして提案している。
pmid-34423782.summary_en: Research investigating ATP6AP2's role in BeWo choriocarcinoma cell syncytialisation and invasion using molecular techniques. Demonstrates that ATP6AP2 is important for differentiation and that soluble ATP6AP2 could serve as a biomarker for invasiveness prediction.

pmid-34425969.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者41名におけるAFPおよびhCG腫瘍マーカーとPET/CT検査結果の相関関係を分析した研究。hCGレベルが代謝パラメータと有意に相関し、感度100%、特異度84%の優れた診断精度を示した。
pmid-34425969.summary_en: Clinical study analyzing correlation between serum tumor markers (AFP, hCG) and 18F-FDG PET/CT findings in 41 seminoma patients post-orchiectomy. PET/CT showed 91% accuracy; hCG levels significantly correlated with metabolic parameters while AFP did not show correlation.

pmid-34426922.summary_ja: 本研究は、化学的HIF誘導物質を用いてBeWo絨毛癌細胞の低酸素反応を検討している。塩化コバルトと水酸キノリン誘導体による異なる低酸素シグナル伝達の活性化を示し、アポトーシス経路の活性化やmTORC1経路の制御を詳細に分析している。
pmid-34426922.summary_en: Study investigating hypoxic signaling in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells using chemical HIF inducers (cobalt chloride and hydroxyquinoline). Shows differential effects on apoptosis and metabolic pathways, with cobalt chloride inducing severe hypoxia-like responses relevant to trophoblast physiology.

pmid-34430123.summary_ja: 71歳男性で、後腹膜のセミノーマに小リンパ球性リンパ腫/慢性リンパ性白血病が同時性に併存した偶発的症例の報告である。細胞学的、組織学的、免疫組織化学的、フローサイトメトリー、蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションの所見が記載されており、この希少な同時性の二重悪性腫瘍の特徴を示している。
pmid-34430123.summary_en: Case report of exceptional presentation: 71-year-old male with incidental seminoma in the retroperitoneum coinciding with small lymphocytic lymphoma/chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Describes cytologic, histologic, immunohistochemical, flow cytometry, and fluorescence in situ hybridization features of this rare synchronous dual malignancy.

pmid-34433169.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおける胚細胞癌と精細胞腫間のDNAメチル化関連遺伝的変化を分析するデータマイニング研究。mRNA発現とDNAメチル化の一致した変化を示す37遺伝子を同定。5つの遺伝子が胚細胞癌で低発現・高メチル化を示し、無再発生存と有意に関連していた。
pmid-34433169.summary_en: Data mining study analyzing DNA methylation-based genetic alterations between embryonal carcinoma and seminoma in testicular GCTs. Identified 37 genes with coordinated changes in mRNA expression and DNA methylation. Five genes (PRDM1, LMO2, FAM53B, HCN4, FAM124B) showed low expression, high methylation in embryonal carcinoma with significant association to relapse-free survival.

pmid-34434536.summary_ja: 純粋精巣絨毛癌を伴う28歳男性の症例報告。精巣腫瘍の1～3%を占める稀なGCT変異型。初診から約9ヶ月後に背部皮膚転移が発症。絨毛癌は血行性播種の傾向が高く、皮膚転移は予後が非常に悪い。
pmid-34434536.summary_en: Case report of 28-year-old male with pure testicular choriocarcinoma, a rare GCT variant comprising 1-3% of testicular tumors. Patient developed cutaneous metastasis to the back approximately 9 months after initial presentation. Choriocarcinoma demonstrates propensity for hematogenous dissemination; cutaneous involvement is exceptionally uncommon with dismal prognosis.

pmid-34435391.summary_ja: 60歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。極めてまれで悪性度の高い胚細胞腫瘍の一亜型で、腫瘍は心臓に浸潤していた。当初は心臓粘液腫が疑われたが、多角的画像診断と化学療法により腫瘍は縮小し、AFP値は低下した。本症例は化学療法により大きな恩恵を受けた。
pmid-34435391.summary_en: Case report of a 60-year-old male with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor, an extremely rare and highly malignant GCT variant. The tumor infiltrated the right atrium and was initially misdiagnosed as cardiac myxoma. Multimodal imaging and subsequent chemotherapy resulted in tumor shrinkage and normalization of AFP levels.

pmid-34438508.summary_ja: Frasier症候群の症例報告であり、巣状分節性糸球体硬化症による難治性ネフローゼ症候群とパフォーマンス症を呈した。患者は卵巣ゴナドブラストーマに由来する悪性混合胚細胞腫瘍を発症し、Frasier症候群における性腺悪性腫瘍監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-34438508.summary_en: Case report of Frasier syndrome presenting with steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome due to focal segmental glomerulosclerosis and pseudo-hermaphroditism. Patient developed a malignant mixed germ cell tumor arising in an ovarian gonadoblastoma, highlighting the critical importance of gonadal malignancy surveillance in Frasier syndrome.

pmid-34440480.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における非コード化RNAとRNAスプライシングの包括的なレビュー。非コード化RNA発現の異常とスプライス変異体がTGCT発育、進行、化学療法耐性、および高度なゲノム安定性維持における役割を検証している。
pmid-34440480.summary_en: Comprehensive review of non-coding RNAs and RNA splicing in testicular germ cell tumors. Examines how aberrant RNA metabolism, including altered non-coding RNA expression and splice variants, influences TGCT development, progression, chemotherapy resistance, and R-loop-mediated genomic stability maintenance.

pmid-34446080.summary_ja: 精巣および縦隔胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を用いたm6Aライター複合体構成要素VIRMAの研究。VIRMA遺伝子ノックダウンにより腫瘍の攻撃性が低下し、シスプラチン感受性が増加した。DNA修復経路の変化を通じてDNA損傷応答が増強され、GCT治療の新規治療標的候補として示唆された。
pmid-34446080.summary_en: Investigation of the m6A writer complex component VIRMA in germ cell tumors using testicular and mediastinal GCT cell lines. VIRMA knockdown reduced tumor aggressiveness, enhanced cisplatin sensitivity, and increased DNA damage through altered DNA repair pathways (XLF, MRE11), offering therapeutic targeting potential for GCT treatment.

pmid-34458506.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節転移検出におけるMRIとCT比較の系統的文献レビュー。127患者を対象とした診断精度研究3件を分析。経験豊富な放射線科医によるMRIの感度80-98%、特異度100%。
pmid-34458506.summary_en: Systematic literature review comparing MRI versus CT for detecting retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis in testicular neoplasms. Analysis of 3 diagnostic accuracy studies involving 127 patients (mean age 29-34 years). MRI showed sensitivity 80-98% and specificity 100% with experienced radiologist.

pmid-34459278.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した原発性卵巣カルチノイド腫瘍4例の後方視的症例集積である。組織亜型は島状型、索状型、甲状腺腫型で、いずれも神経内分泌マーカーに陽性であった。12～71か月のフォローアップ期間中、再発や転移は認められなかった。
pmid-34459278.summary_en: Retrospective case series of four primary ovarian carcinoid tumors arising from mature cystic teratomas. Subtypes: insular (1), trabecular (1), strumal (2). All showed neuroendocrine markers. No recurrence or metastasis during 12-71 month follow-up.

pmid-34459784.summary_ja: 奇胎に続発した絨毛癌の転移症例。37歳女性が腎疝痛と皮膚病変で発症し、肺・腎・脳転移を認めた。β-hCG 394,590 mIU/mLと著明上昇。皮膚転移は極めて稀で報告は13例程度。
pmid-34459784.summary_en: Case of metastatic choriocarcinoma following hydatidiform mole in 37-year-old woman presenting with renal colic and skin lesions. Detected multiple metastases to lung, kidney, and brain. β-hCG dramatically elevated at 394,590 mIU/mL. Very rare with only 13 prior cutaneous metastasis cases reported.

pmid-34463327.summary_ja: 分娩後患者における21cm縦隔奇形腫の症例報告。ポリオ病歴を有する患者の大型縦隔腫瘤の麻酔管理上の困難と安全管理法について論述。
pmid-34463327.summary_en: Case report of 21cm symptomatic intrathoracic teratoma (mediastinal GCT) in postpartum patient with history of poliomyelitis. Discusses anesthetic management challenges and techniques for safely managing large mediastinal mass with potential neuromuscular disease.

pmid-34466387.summary_ja: 40歳男性の未降下精巣による腹部腫瘤がセミノーマと診断された症例。腹腔内未降下精巣は稀な部位だが悪性化の危険があり、化学療法が奏効。
pmid-34466387.summary_en: Case report of 40-year-old man with unilateral undescended testis (UDT) presenting as intra-abdominal mass, revealed as seminoma. Intra-abdominal UDT is rare location but carries malignancy risk. Chemotherapy produced remarkable response.

pmid-34473871.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫内の松果体分化の初報告3例。6歳男児の頸部腫瘤と23・45歳女性の後腹膜腫瘤。全例が成熟扁平上皮と松果体特異的マーカー(シナプトフィジン、ニューロフィラメント蛋白)を示した。
pmid-34473871.summary_en: First report of three cases of mature teratomas with pineal gland differentiation: 6-year-old with neck mass, 23 and 45-year-old females with retroperitoneal masses. All showed mature squamous epithelium, glial differentiation, and pineal-specific immunohistochemical markers.

pmid-34475040.summary_ja: 組織マイクロアレイを用いて、精巣セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるシスタチオニンγ-リアーゼ（CSE）の発現を検討した研究である。良性精巣組織と比較して、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍でCSE発現が増加していたが、成熟奇形腫では増加していなかった。
pmid-34475040.summary_en: Study examining cystathionine gamma-lyase (CSE) expression in testicular germ cell tumors using tissue microarrays. CSE expression increased in seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and yolk sac tumors compared to benign tissue, but not in mature teratomas.

pmid-34481709.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性267例（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍115例、セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍152例）を対象に、進行病期と関連する因子を検討した研究である。精子形成の欠如と胎児性癌の割合が高いことは、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における転移性疾患と関連していた。
pmid-34481709.summary_en: Study of 267 men with testicular germ cell tumors (115 NSGCT, 152 SGCT) to identify factors associated with advanced disease. Absence of spermatogenesis and high proportion of embryonal carcinoma correlated with metastatic NSGCT.

pmid-34484530.summary_ja: 45歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞奇形腫の悪性変化と小腸転移の稀な症例。扁平上皮癌が最も一般的な悪性変化であり、早期発見が重要で治療なしでは死亡率が高い。
pmid-34484530.summary_en: Rare case of 45-year-old woman with mature cystic ovarian teratoma (MCOT) showing malignant degeneration with distant small bowel metastasis. Squamous cell carcinoma is most common malignant transformation. Early detection critical as mortality high if untreated.

pmid-34488323.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の稀なサブタイプである上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)の症例。37歳女性が不正出血で発症。β-HCG正常または軽度上昇だが、50%で転移の可能性がある極めて稀な腫瘍。
pmid-34488323.summary_en: Case report of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), an extremely rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and subtype of placental site trophoblastic tumor. 37-year-old woman presented with irregular vaginal bleeding. β-HCG levels normal or slightly elevated with potential for metastasis.

pmid-34493243.summary_ja: 妊娠分娩中に発見された卵巣ジスゲルミノーマ。26cm骨盤腫瘤が陣痛異常と大量血腹症を引き起こしたが、腫瘍切除後6ヶ月間再発なし。
pmid-34493243.summary_en: Rare case of ovarian dysgerminoma (malignant germ cell tumor) discovered during labor in healthy multigravida. The 26cm pelvic mass caused abnormal labor progression and massive hemoperitoneum. Tumor successfully resected with no recurrence at 6 months.

pmid-34497984.summary_ja: 再発した後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍を有する70歳男性の症例報告。hCG値は上昇したが従来の画像検査では再発が認められなかった。背景体信号抑制を用いた拡散強調全身画像法により仙骨の転移病変が検出された。患者は局所放射線療法と救援化学療法を受けた後、長期の無再発生存を得た。
pmid-34497984.summary_en: Case report of 70-year-old man with relapsed retroperitoneal germ cell tumor. Although hCG levels elevated, conventional imaging showed no recurrence. Diffusion-weighted whole-body imaging detected metastatic sacral lesions; patient achieved long-term recurrence-free survival.

pmid-34497985.summary_ja: 小児精巣成熟奇形腫6患者7精巣に対する精巣温存手術の症例シリーズ。経鼠径部または陰嚢からアプローチで腫瘍核出し、正常精巣組織を温存。3年以上観察で再発なし。
pmid-34497985.summary_en: Case series of testis-sparing surgery for pediatric mature teratoma in 6 children (7 testes). Via transinguinal or scrotal approach, tumors were enucleated with preservation of normal testicular tissue. No recurrence with minimum 3-year follow-up.

pmid-34502216.summary_ja: 治療から1.5年後に再発した縦隔腫瘍を呈した思春期男性の症例。血清腫瘍マーカー(AFP、hCG)は陰性であった。分子解析により、原発胚細胞腫瘍とクローン性に関連する二次性非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍(平滑筋肉腫および神経内分泌癌)が明らかとなった。
pmid-34502216.summary_en: Adolescent male with recurrent mediastinal tumor 1.5 years after treatment of malignant germ-cell tumor. Serum tumor markers (AFP, hCG) negative. Molecular analysis revealed secondary non-germ cell malignancies (leiomyosarcoma and neuroendocrine carcinoma) clonally related to primary GCT.

pmid-34503070.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を監視するリキッドバイオプシーのバイオマーカーであるmiR-371a-3pについて、miRNA単離法を比較した研究。正常男性および精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清・血漿を、Qiagen抽出法とTaqManビーズ捕捉法で解析した。
pmid-34503070.summary_en: Study comparing miRNA isolation protocols for miR-371a-3p, a liquid-biopsy biomarker monitoring malignant testicular germ cell tumors. Analyzed serum and plasma from normal males and testicular GCT patients using Qiagen extraction and TaqMan bead-capture methods.

pmid-34504774.summary_ja: 多精巣症に伴う精巣セミノーマの稀な症例。57歳男性の鼠径管の精巣様腫瘤がセミノーマと診断され、肺・肝転移を認めた。
pmid-34504774.summary_en: Rare case of polyorchidism with testicular seminoma in 57-year-old man. An undescended testis-like mass in the inguinal canal showed histopathological features of seminoma with lung and liver metastasis detected on CT scan.

pmid-34507189.summary_ja: 混合型非セミノーマ性腫瘍として提示された、まれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である十二指腸奇形腫の症例。26歳男性が心窩部痛と10×15cmの不均一な腫瘤を呈した。最終診断は、外科的切除後に確認された悪性変化を伴わない奇形腫性腫瘍であった。
pmid-34507189.summary_en: Rare case of duodenal teratoma, an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting as mixed non-seminomatous tumor. 26-year-old man presented with epigastric pain and 10×15cm heterogeneous mass. Final diagnosis: teratomatous tumor of duodenum without malignant changes following surgical resection.

pmid-34513476.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)は一般的な良性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例は、脂肪が少なく甲状腺組織に富む左卵巣類皮嚢腫が自然破裂し、化学的腹膜炎を呈したものを記述している。MR画像シーケンスにより、嚢腫腔内のわずかな脂肪を効果的に検出できた。
pmid-34513476.summary_en: Mature cystic teratoma (MCT) is a common benign ovarian germ cell tumor. This case describes spontaneous rupture of a lipid-poor, thyroid tissue-rich left ovarian dermoid presenting with chemical peritonitis. MR imaging sequences effectively detected minimal fat in the cyst cavity.

pmid-34513727.summary_ja: 侵襲性胞状奇胎と絨毛癌患者の腸内微生物叢多様性の研究。α多様性とβ多様性は侵襲性胞状奇胎と対照間で有意差。がん関連遺伝子の豊度が両疾患で増加。19科39属で有意差。Prevotella_7が侵襲性胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の潜在的バイオマーカー。腸内微生物叢の診断マーカーと治療標的としての可能性。
pmid-34513727.summary_en: Study of gut microbiome diversity in invasive mole (IM) and choriocarcinoma (CC) patients versus healthy controls. Alpha and beta diversity significantly different between IM and controls, but not between CC and controls. Abundance of cancer-related genes increased in both IM and CC patients. Nineteen families and 39 genera showed significant differences. Prevotella_7 identified as potential biomarker for IM, CC, and controls, suggesting gut microbiota as diagnostic markers and treatment targets.

pmid-34513760.summary_ja: 思春期の「燃焼尽くした」精巣胚細胞腫瘍の単一施設臨床経験。原発性精巣腫瘍11例と燃焼尽くした腫瘍5例を分析。燃焼尽くした腫瘍は全身症状（80% vs 0%）、高いaFP/hCG/LDH値、高い治療関連毒性と関連。全生存期間（15 vs 43か月）と無増悪生存期間（12 vs 38か月）で不良予後。臨床的に独立した疾患概念。
pmid-34513760.summary_en: Single-institution experience with burned-out testicular tumors in adolescents. Eleven patients with primary testicular tumors and five with burned-out presentation analyzed. Burned-out tumors associated with systemic symptoms (80% vs 0%), higher aFP/hCG/LDH levels (p<0.00001), and higher treatment-related toxicity (80% vs 18%). Burned-out group had worse overall survival (15 vs 43 months) and event-free survival (12 vs 38 months). Represents distinct clinical entity with poor prognosis.

pmid-34517152.summary_ja: インフルエンザB感染の数日後に発症した小児の抗NMDAR受容体脳炎の症例報告で、成熟卵巣奇形腫を伴っていた。精神病、けいれん、運動障害などの神経症状が、インフルエンザB発症直後に出現した。症状出現から10日目に奇形腫を同定し摘出した。その後6か月でほぼ完全に症状が回復した。著者らは、小児集団における抗NMDA脳炎とインフルエンザBの関連について焦点を絞った文献レビューを行っている。
pmid-34517152.summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDAR receptor encephalitis in child presenting days after influenza B infection associated with mature ovarian teratoma. Neurological symptoms including psychosis, seizures, and movement disorders appeared shortly after influenza B onset. Mature ovarian teratoma identified and removed on day 10 after symptom appearance. Nearly complete symptom resolution over subsequent 6 months. Authors provide focused literature review of anti-NMDA encephalitis in pediatric population and influenza B association.

pmid-34520046.summary_ja: 第一選択療法に抵抗性の重症抗NMDAR脳炎患者4例の症例集積。全例で集中治療と人工呼吸管理が必要であったが、免疫吸着療法後に緩徐かつ着実な改善が見られた。12か月時点でmRS 2と良好な転帰を示した症例もあった。
pmid-34520046.summary_en: Case series of four severe anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients refractory to first-line therapy (IVMP and IVIG). Two patients had teratoma; two with unknown origin. All required ICU support including mechanical ventilation. Immunoadsorption performed during fulminant disease stage. Gradual and steady improvement observed after IA treatment. Two patients achieved good early recovery on discharge; other two had good outcome with modified Rankin Scale score of 2 at 12-month follow-up.

pmid-34521185.summary_ja: 成人後頭窩奇形腫の系統的レビューと症例報告。2例の施設症例と16例の医学文献報告を検討（計18例）。頭痛が最も一般的（55.6%）。MRIで異質性信号。72.2%が中線部位、27.8%が石灰化。全例で外科的摘除を施行、再発なし。画像所見のみでは誤診の可能性あり、病理診断が必須と強調。
pmid-34521185.summary_en: Systematic review and case series of posterior fossa teratomas in adults (extremely rare occurrence). Authors report two institutional cases and reviewed 16 published cases (total 18 cases analyzed). Headache most common symptom (55.6%). Heterogeneous MRI signals; 72.2% midline location; 27.8% calcification. Surgical resection performed in all patients; no recurrence reported post-resection. Authors emphasize pathological confirmation essential as radiographic diagnosis alone can lead to misdiagnosis.

pmid-34527124.summary_ja: 26歳男性に生じた破裂縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。単純X線およびCTで、辺縁増強・部分石灰化・内部脂肪濃度を示す腫瘤が認められた。外科的切除で腫瘤は胸腺と大動脈弓に癒着していた。画像診断による速やかな診断と完全な外科的切除を行った。
pmid-34527124.summary_en: Case report of ruptured mediastinal cystic teratoma in 26-year-old male. Mediastinal germ cell tumors uncommon anterior mediastinal masses. Plain radiograph and CT imaging showed characteristic features of ruptured cystic teratoma: peripherally enhancing, partially calcified mass with internal fat density. Surgical excision performed; mass adhered to thymus and anterior aortic arch. Prompt diagnosis via imaging and complete surgical resection achieved.

pmid-34532178.summary_ja: 初回精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍治療後17年の晩期小脳転移の症例報告。32歳患者で大きな小脳腫瘤が認められた。後頭下開頭術で全摘出を達成したが、術後4週MRIで急速な再発を認めた。腫瘍の侵襲的性質から早期の化学療法と放射線治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-34532178.summary_en: Case report of late testicular yolk sac tumor (YST) recurrence presenting as cerebellar metastasis 17 years after primary treatment. 32-year-old with YST history presented with large cerebellar mass. Suboccipital craniotomy and gross total resection performed. Despite complete resection on postoperative MRI, rapid tumor recurrence evident at 4-week follow-up. Authors emphasize aggressive nature necessitates early chemotherapy and radiation rather than delayed approach.

pmid-34538241.summary_ja: ハンガリーにおける精巣胚細胞がんの転帰に対する社会経済的要因を検討した前向き研究。社会経済的地位が低い患者は治療遅延が長く、死亡率も高かった。受診遅延が1年を超えると転帰が悪化し、特に非セミノーマで教育水準が重要な決定因子であった。
pmid-34538241.summary_en: Prospective study of socioeconomic factors affecting testicular germ cell cancer (TGCC) outcomes in Hungary. Patients with lower socioeconomic status experienced significantly longer treatment delays and higher mortality. Cancer-specific mortality highest in lowest social quartile (13.09% vs 1.56% in highest). Patient delay >1 year associated with worse outcomes (57.2% deceased vs 8.0% survivors). Education level important determinant of treatment delay, particularly in non-seminoma.

pmid-34538870.summary_ja: 絨毛癌のceRNA networkの生物情報学的解析。栄養膜と絨毛癌細胞株間で177のmRNAと189のmiRNAが差異発現。10個のハブ遺伝子を同定。5つのlncRNA（LINC00261、MEG3、MALAT1、H19、OGFRP1）が絨毛癌の主要調節因子。絨毛癌の機序に新しい知見と潜在的治療標的を提供。
pmid-34538870.summary_en: Bioinformatic analysis of competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) network in choriocarcinoma. Study identified 177 differentially expressed mRNAs and 189 miRNAs between trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cell lines. Ten hub genes identified. Five lncRNAs (LINC00261, MEG3, MALAT1, H19, OGFRP1) identified as key regulators in choriocarcinoma. Results provide novel insights into choriocarcinoma mechanisms and identify potential therapeutic targets for future treatment strategies.

pmid-34539919.summary_ja: 45,X/46,XY混合生殖腺異形成患者5例の成長ホルモン動態研究。1例で性腺胚細胞腫瘍（ジスゲルミノーマ）を報告。IGF-1とGH値はGH分泌不全と抵抗性の両特徴を示した。成長減速はGH分泌不全と抵抗性の両者が関与。MGD患者は性腺腫瘍高リスク。GH療法前に性腺摘除/生検が必須。第二腫瘍の厳重観察が必要。
pmid-34539919.summary_en: Study of growth hormone dynamics in five children with 45,X/46,XY mixed gonadal dysgenesis (MGD). One subject developed gonadal germ cell tumor (dysgerminoma). IGF-1 and GH levels showed features of both GH deficiency and insensitivity. Growth deceleration partly due to defective GH secretion and partly to GH insensitivity. MGD associated with high gonadal tumor risk; gonadectomy or biopsy essential before GH therapy. Close surveillance for second neoplasm recommended.

pmid-34540509.summary_ja: 42歳女性において、乳癌、子宮平滑筋腫、卵巣奇形腫が同時に認められた症例報告。甲状腺濾胞腺腫の既往もあった。資源の限られた環境では、臨床的な強い疑い、多職種による管理、フォローアップが同時性腫瘍の管理に不可欠であると述べている。
pmid-34540509.summary_en: Case report of synchronous breast carcinoma, uterine leiomyoma, and ovarian teratoma in 42-year-old woman with prior thyroid follicular adenoma. Multiple primary tumors in invasive ductal carcinoma patients rare in literature. Case highlights diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of concurrent malignancies. In resource-limited settings lacking genetic screening facilities, strong clinical suspicion, multidisciplinary management, and follow-up remain essential for managing synchronous neoplasia.

pmid-34548993.summary_ja: 小腸転移で初発した精巣セミノーマの症例報告。精巣GCTは精巣がんの95%、全生存率約95%だが遠隔転移で予後悪化。42歳男性、消化管症状で小腸腫瘤が認められセミノーマ転移と確診。セミノーマの消化管転移は1%未満。若年男性の腹部症状では精巣原発腫瘍を考慮すべき。
pmid-34548993.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma presenting with small bowel metastasis. Testicular GCT accounts for 95% testicular cancers with ~95% overall survival; prognosis worsens with distant metastasis. 42-year-old with GI symptoms; CT imaging revealed small bowel mass confirmed as seminoma metastasis on endoscopic biopsy. GI metastases rare (<1% in seminoma). Clinicians should maintain high suspicion in young males with unexplained abdominal symptoms and consider testicular primary.

pmid-34549072.summary_ja: 消化管出血で発症した転移性精巣胚細胞癌の症例報告。精巣がんは20-35歳男性で最も一般的。消化管転移は稀だが若年男性の原因不明出血では考慮すべき。後腹膜リンパ節が最も一般的な転移部位。他の原因が除外された場合、精巣原発腫瘍の評価が重要。
pmid-34549072.summary_en: Case report of metastatic testicular embryonal carcinoma presenting as gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Testicular cancer most common malignancy in men aged 20-35 years, typically presenting with painless scrotal swelling. Gastrointestinal metastases rare but should be considered in young males with unexplained GI bleeding. Retroperitoneal lymph nodes most common metastatic site. Case highlights importance of evaluating for primary testicular malignancy when other causes ruled out.

pmid-34549182.summary_ja: ゲルミノーマ114例における予後予測因子の研究。腫瘍細胞含有率は5-90%と広範に分布（中央値50%）。女性患者で腫瘍細胞含有率が高い。異型部位では無増悪生存期間が短い。高含有率（≥50%）は低含有率（<50%）より予後不良。多変量解析で腫瘍細胞含有率のみが有意な予後因子。病理学的因子の重要性を示唆。
pmid-34549182.summary_en: Study of prognostic factors in 114 germinoma patients. Tumor cell content widely distributed (5-90%, median 50%). Female patients showed higher tumor cell content. Atypical site location associated with shorter progression-free survival (PFS). Higher tumor cell content (≥50%) associated with shorter PFS than lower content (<50%). In multivariate analysis, tumor cell content was only statistically significant prognostic factor. Findings suggest importance of pathological factors for treatment stratification.

pmid-34549395.summary_ja: 成人の抗NMDAR脳炎患者を対象に、てんかん重積状態(SE)の制御因子を検討した研究。8例中7例(87.5%)がSEを呈し、持続期間は3.6±3.9日であった。免疫療法前にSEを生じた5例はAED単独(4例)または奇形腫摘出併用(1例)で制御された。難治性SEの発症が遅いほど持続期間が短く、SE前のAED使用期間が長いほど関連があった。全例がAEDおよび免疫療法により発作消失を達成した。
pmid-34549395.summary_en: Study of status epilepticus (SE) determinants in adult anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients. Eight patients analyzed; seven (87.5%) experienced SE lasting 3.6±3.9 days. Five had SE before immunotherapy, successfully controlled by antiepileptic drugs alone (n=4) or combined with teratoma resection (n=1). Later SE onset associated with shorter duration and longer prior AED use. All cases achieved seizure freedom after AEDs and immunotherapy.

pmid-34556456.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の生殖能力温存に関する患者中心的管理方針。精巣がんに伴う不妊症は一般的だが臨床的に見落とされやすい。治療前の基本的妊孕性評価が不可欠。腫瘍治療を遅延させない妊孕性温存戦略の実装と患者の生活の質の大幅な改善を実現。
pmid-34556456.summary_en: Patient-centered approach to fertility management for testicular cancer patients. Addresses common subfertility in testicular cancer, often overlooked in clinical practice. Baseline fertility assessments essential before oncological intervention. Enables implementation of patient-centered fertility preservation pathway that maximizes fertility preservation while avoiding delays in cancer treatment and significantly improving quality of life.

pmid-34557461.summary_ja: 乳幼児の精巣混合胚細胞腫瘍の極めて稀な症例報告。思春期前のMGCTは医学文献での報告は従来1例のみであった。無痛陰嚢腫瘤で発症、精巣摘除術で腫瘍は精巣内に限局。画像検査と腫瘍マーカーが治療決定に必須。適切な管理により思春期前精巣GCTは良好な予後が期待される。
pmid-34557461.summary_en: Case report of rare mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT) in infant with testicular presentation. Prepubertal MGCT extremely rare with only one previous case reported in literature. Patient presented with painless scrotal mass; orchiectomy revealed MGCT limited to testis without spread. Ultrasonography, computed tomography, and tumor markers integral to treatment determination. Prudent management typically yields favorable prognosis for prepubertal testicular GCT.

pmid-34557666.summary_ja: KLHL11抗体関連傍腫瘍性神経症候群の臨床的特徴と免疫病態に関する研究。11例中82%に関連腫瘍、78%は自然退縮した精巣胚細胞腫瘍であった。全例に小脳症候群、5例に辺縁系脳炎、2例に脊髄炎。MATCH score（男性、失調、精巣がん、聴覚障害）でKLHL11陽性患者を高感度・特異度で同定。T細胞媒介性病態を実証。
pmid-34557666.summary_en: Retrospective and prospective study of KLHL11-antibody-associated paraneoplastic neurological syndrome. 11 patients identified; 82% had associated cancer, predominantly spontaneously regressed (burned-out) testicular germ cell tumors (78%). All manifested cerebellar syndrome; additional features included limbic encephalitis and myelitis. MATCH score (male, ataxia, testicular cancer, hearing alterations) with cutoff ≥4 effectively identified KLHL11-positive patients (sensitivity 78%, specificity 99%). T-cell mediated pathogenesis demonstrated.

pmid-34561925.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマを伴うKLHL11関連傍腫瘍性神経症候群の症例報告。42歳男性が進行性の運動失調と感音性難聴を呈し、神経症状出現の11か月後に転移性セミノーマが検出された。連続的な脳MRIでは、ホットクロスバン徴候を伴う進行性の脳幹および小脳萎縮と、感受性強調画像での信号変化が認められた。脳脊髄液および血清でKLHL11抗体が濃縮され、免疫組織化学によりセミノーマ組織中のKLHL11が確認された。
pmid-34561925.summary_en: Case of KLHL11-associated paraneoplastic neurological syndrome with metastatic seminoma. 42-year-old male presented with progressive ataxia and sensorineural hearing loss; metastatic seminoma detected 11 months after neurological onset. Serial brain MRI revealed progressive brainstem and cerebellar atrophy with hot-cross-bun sign and signal changes on susceptibility-weighted imaging. KLHL11 antibodies enriched in CSF and serum; immunohistochemistry confirmed KLHL11 in seminoma tissue.

pmid-34567852.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞奇形腫から尿路上皮癌への極めて稀な悪性転化症例。成熟奇形腫の0.17-2%のみ悪性転化し、そのうち尿路上皮癌は稀。左卵巣摘除術施行、病理で尿路上皮癌と診断。拡大手術後ステージIAで良好な経過、6か月後再発なし。
pmid-34567852.summary_en: Rare case of urothelial carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of ovary in 58-year-old woman. Approximately 0.17-2% of mature teratomas undergo malignant transformation; urothelial transformation extremely rare. Left salpingo-oophorectomy performed; pathology confirmed urothelial carcinoma morphologically and immunohistochemically. Extended staging surgery performed; patient stage IA with good postoperative course, no recurrence at 6-month follow-up.

pmid-34567894.summary_ja: 妊娠中に卵巣捻転を引き起こした成熟嚢胞奇形腫の症例報告。22歳患者が急性腹痛で発症。超音波検査とMRIで所見が不確定だったが、腹腔鏡検査で3回転の卵巣捻転を確認。右卵巣摘除術施行、病理で成熟奇形腫と診断。5-10cm卵巣腫瘤への予防的手術介入を推奨。
pmid-34567894.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma causing ovarian torsion during pregnancy. 22-year-old presented with acute lower abdominal pain. Despite uncertain imaging on ultrasound and MRI, diagnostic laparoscopy revealed three-fold torsion around utero-ovarian ligament. Right oophorectomy performed with pathological confirmation of benign mature teratoma. Author recommends prophylactic surgical intervention for ovarian masses 5-10 cm.

pmid-34568223.summary_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するHDCT/ASCTの臨床経験報告。初回BEP化学療法後の患者3例がHDCT/ASCTで全例完全奏効を達成。高用量カルボプラチンとエトポシドを使用。全例で3/4度の毒性（骨髄抑制、下痢、粘膜炎）を認めた。再発精巣GCTに対して実行可能で安全かつ有効。
pmid-34568223.summary_en: High-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) and autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT) in relapsed testicular GCT. Case series of three patients treated with BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) initially, achieving complete remission after HDCT/ASCT with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide. Grade 3/4 toxicities included myelosuppression, diarrhea, and mucositis. Authors conclude HDCT/ASCT feasible, safe, and effective for relapsed testicular GCT.

pmid-34573885.summary_ja: 妊娠21週で検出された胎児縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例。腫瘤は進行性に増大し、心嚢液貯留を伴った。病理組織学的検査でNorris分類grade 2の未熟奇形腫と確認され、核型は46,XXであった。出生前超音波診断の重要性と、子宮内手術、EXIT手技、出生後の外科的切除を含む管理の選択肢について考察している。
pmid-34573885.summary_en: Fetal case of mediastinal immature teratoma detected at 21 weeks gestation with progressive growth and pericardial effusions. Histopathology confirmed Norris grade 2 immature teratoma with 46,XX karyotype. Discusses prenatal ultrasound diagnosis importance and management options including in utero surgery, EXIT procedure, and postnatal surgical resection for optimal fetal outcome.

pmid-34580125.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌がhCG誘導甲状腺ストームで初発。hCG値は超高値（希釈後676万mIU/mL）。前ゾーン効果の認識が重要。
pmid-34580125.summary_en: Rare case of testicular choriocarcinoma presenting as thyroid storm from hCG-induced hyperthyroidism. Extremely elevated hCG levels (6.76 million mIU/mL after dilution testing revealed prozone effect). Patient presented with acute thyrotoxicosis symptoms including tachycardia, fever, and icterus. Emphasizes risks of iodinated contrast with hCG-producing tumors and need for dilution testing when hCG markedly elevated.

pmid-34583437.summary_ja: 口蓋から生じる先天性顔面奇形腫。3D再構成モデルで手術計画を立案。成熟奇形腫で口唇口蓋裂を伴う。
pmid-34583437.summary_en: Case of congenital orofacial teratoma (epignathus) arising from palatal sphenoid region in newborn, occurring in 1:35,000-200,000 live births. Used virtual 3D reconstruction models for surgical planning of en bloc resection. Tumor diagnosed as mature teratoma with associated cleft lip/palate and nasoethmoid meningocele. 3D technology improved understanding of tumor relationship to adjacent structures.

pmid-34584425.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性で、マイクロサテライト不安定性（MSI）が高い精巣胚細胞腫瘍の希少症例で、ペムブロリズマブに急速な反応を示した。2回投与後にhCG値が6500から1.0 IU/L未満に低下した。PET-CTでは後腹膜リンパ節転移の縮小が認められ、6か月以上にわたり無病状態が続いている。チェックポイント阻害薬に反応した難治性のMSI高発TGCTとしては初の報告である。
pmid-34584425.summary_en: Rare case of chemo-refractory testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) with high microsatellite instability (MSI) showing rapid response to pembrolizumab. hCG levels dropped dramatically from 6500 to <1.0 IU/L after two doses. PET-CT showed retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis shrinkage with 6+ months disease-free survival. First report of refractory TGCT with MSI-high responding to checkpoint inhibitor.

pmid-34584723.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の症例報告。40歳を超える患者で充実成分が広範囲にみられる場合は悪性腫瘍を強く疑うべきとしている。奇形腫症例では悪性転化を検出するため、組織の十分なサンプリングと長期のフォローアップの必要性を強調している。
pmid-34584723.summary_en: Case of squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Notes that extensive solid component in patients aged >40 years warrants strong suspicion for malignancy. Emphasizes need for thorough tissue sampling and prolonged patient follow-up to detect potential malignant transformation in teratoma cases.

pmid-34585559.summary_ja: 28歳女性の巨大縦隔奇形腫。包括的な多検査画像診断により診断と手術計画を確立。統合的画像評価の重要性。
pmid-34585559.summary_en: Case report of giant mediastinal teratoma in 28-year-old female. Integrated multi-modality imaging work-up including comprehensive radiographic evaluation to define diagnosis and guide surgical planning. Demonstrates importance of detailed imaging characterization for determining most appropriate surgical intervention approach.

pmid-34586943.summary_ja: 未成熟腸間膜奇形腫切除後の腹腔外神経膠腫症腹膜炎の稀な症例。完全切除と生涯フォローアップが重要。
pmid-34586943.summary_en: Rare case of extratesticular gliomatosis peritonei (GP) developing after mesenteric teratoma excision in 3-year-old boy. Mesenteric teratoma is uncommon extragonadal teratoma. Findings included ductile tissue on terminal spermatic cord and epididymis. Complete teratoma resection with partial GP removal; patient requires lifelong follow-up for potential malignant transformation.

pmid-34589457.summary_ja: 臍帯奇形腫を伴う先天性臍帯ヘルニアの稀な症例。成熟奇形腫と腹壁形成術を単一段階で施行。術後経過良好。
pmid-34589457.summary_en: Rare case report of congenital omphalocele combined with umbilical mature teratoma in newborn. Successful single-stage surgical treatment combining teratoma removal with abdominoplasty performed on first postoperative day. Uneventful postoperative course with discharge for recovery, demonstrating successful management of this rare congenital presentation.

pmid-34592590.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛性疾患治療における免疫原性細胞死の役割仮説。GTNの独特な遺伝的背景が免疫療法反応を向上させる可能性。
pmid-34592590.summary_en: Hypothesis on immunogenic cell death (ICD) role in gestational trophoblastic neoplasm (GTN) treatment. Proposes that GTN's unique genomic makeup and high tumor antigenicity may enhance immunotherapy response compared to non-gestational trophoblastic tumors. Discusses potential of GTN as archetype for immuno-oncological research due to exclusive genetic inheritance.

pmid-34594559.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫に伴う神経膠腫症腹膜炎の症例。GP病変の良性特性の認識と長期フォローアップの重要性を強調。
pmid-34594559.summary_en: Case report of mature ovarian teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei (GP). Emphasizes the importance of recognizing the benign nature of GP when associated with mature ovarian teratoma. Primary tumor treatment and long-term follow-up are vital for patient management and potential malignant transformation surveillance.

pmid-34597218.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分類、病理学的特徴、遺伝学的特徴、管理を網羅した画像診断の包括的レビュー。2016年WHO分類でGCNISと非GCNISの腫瘍を区別する点、診断と病期分類における画像診断の役割、セミノーマ(化学療法・放射線療法に感受性)と奇形腫(化学療法抵抗性)の治療の違いを論じている。
pmid-34597218.summary_en: Comprehensive radiographic review of testicular germ cell tumors covering classification, pathologic features, genetic characteristics, and management. Discusses WHO 2016 classification distinguishing GCNIS and non-GCNIS tumors, imaging role in diagnosis and staging, and treatment differences between seminomas (chemo/radiation sensitive) and teratomas (chemotherapy resistant).

pmid-34606083.summary_ja: 精巣非精上皮腫に対するロボット支援対腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の比較。ロボット支援は手術時間、ドレーン抜去時間、入院期間が短縮。がん学的予後は同等。
pmid-34606083.summary_en: Comparative study of robotic-assisted (R-RPLND) versus laparoscopic (L-RPLND) retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. R-RPLND showed significantly shorter operative time, faster drain removal, and shorter hospital stay. Oncologic outcomes and complication rates were comparable between approaches.

pmid-34608421.summary_ja: 25歳女性の原発性卵巣絨毛癌（おそらく妊娠関連）。血清hCG高値と組織診で確定診断。化学療法に良好に反応。
pmid-34608421.summary_en: Case report of primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, likely gestational in origin, in 25-year-old parous woman presenting with abdominal pain and swelling. Diagnosis confirmed by elevated serum beta-hCG and histology. Treated with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin regimen with effective response. Emphasizes importance of beta-hCG testing for adnexal masses.

pmid-34610710.summary_ja: 18歳男性の難治性非精上皮腫。絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胚細胞癌を含む。複数の化学療法、手術、放射線治療で18ヶ月無病生存を達成。
pmid-34610710.summary_en: Case of 18-year-old male with advanced choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonal carcinoma with retroperitoneal, hepatic, pulmonary, and cerebral metastases. After multiple chemotherapy regimens failed, combined surgical debulking, radiation therapy, and additional chemotherapy resulted in negative tumor markers and disease-free status at 1.5 years post-lung resection.
